descriptionByLocale.it:
Cosa farai
Ti unirai a uno dei gruppi di fisica sperimentale del CERN, se selezionato per questo Research Fellowship, per sviluppare e condurre il tuo programma di ricerca alla frontiera della fisica delle particelle. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e internazionale, analizzando i dati, contribuendo alla progettazione, costruzione e/o operazioni dei rivelatori e impegnando nella progettazione, esecuzione e interpretazione delle analisi dei dati fisici. Sarete anche parte della vivace comunità scientifica del CERN attraverso seminari, workshop, attività di formazione e progetti collaborativi.
I compiti chiave

• Si conduce la ricerca in fisica sperimentale all'interno di un gruppo di ricerca CERN di vostra scelta.

• Contribuisci al programma di fisica sperimentale del CERN utilizzando i suoi strumenti scientifici su larga scala.

• Collabori con fisici e ingegneri su studi di interazioni di particelle e attività di ricerca correlate.

• Sviluppi e persegui i tuoi interessi di ricerca nell'ambito della Fellowship.
Il tuo profilo

• Hai un forte background nella fisica delle particelle sperimentali o in un campo strettamente correlato.

• Hai esperienza di ricerca allineata con le attività scientifiche svolte presso le strutture sperimentali del CERN.

• Siete motivati a unire un gruppo di ricerca e contribuire al lavoro scientifico ad alto impatto.

• Siete desiderosi di sviluppare e perseguire i vostri interessi di ricerca all'interno del quadro di Fellowship.
Le tue competenze

• Hai solide competenze analitiche e problem solving nel contesto della fisica sperimentale.

• Sei in grado di lavorare in collaborazione all'interno di grandi e internazionali team scientifici.

• Si comunica efficacemente in un ambiente scientifico, tra cui presentare e discutere i risultati della ricerca.

• È possibile lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo a obiettivi di ricerca condivisi e progetti collaborativi.

• Scadenza domanda: 01/09/2026 a 23:59 (Ginevra Tempo)

• Data di inizio ideale: 01/02/2027

• Durata del contratto: tipicamente contratto 24 mesi. Un piccolo numero di candidati eccezionali sarà offerto una borsa di studio di 36 mesi

• Ore lavorative settimanali: 40

• Flessibilità del lavoro: Fully Onsite

• Ubicazione: Ginevra, Svizzera

• Riferimento del lavoro: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Vantaggi globali

• Una spesa mensile tra 7004-7425 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.

• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.

• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.

• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.

• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

• On-the-job e formazione formale, comprese le lezioni di lingua.
Assicurarsi di soddisfare i criteri di ammissibilità

• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato . Attualmente, non possiamo considerare le domande dei cittadini pakistano e lituano per posizioni con una data di inizio del 2026, in quanto il massimale definito dall'articolo II.5 dell'accordo di associazione è stato raggiunto. Alcune eccezioni sono possibili annualmente.

• Con la scadenza della domanda, si dispone di un PhD (o lo otterrà entro sei mesi), e non più di 6 anni di esperienza di ricerca dopo il completamento del dottorato di ricerca.

• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.

• Siete pregati di notare che i membri dello Staff del CERN possono richiedere un Fellowship.

• Questa Avviso di Vacancy è per la fisica sperimentale. Se invece il vostro campo è scienza applicata e ingegneria, o fisica teorica. si prega di consultare posizioni aperte all'interno del programma disponibile nella pagina del Programma di Fellowship .

• Si prega di prestare attenzione ai criteri e ai requisiti aggiuntivi per questa specifica posizione e menzionato sopra.
Avrete bisogno di questi documenti per completare la vostra applicazione

• Il tuo CV (inglese o francese)

• Una copia del diploma più rilevante o un certificato di successo dalla tua università (se non hai ancora il diploma di carta)

• Una dichiarazione di una pagina di interessi di ricerca ad alta fedeltà i vostri piani per la borsa di ricerca (massimo 4.000 caratteri).

• Tre recenti lettere di raccomandazione (non più di un anno al termine della domanda) che delineano i vostri risultati accademici e/o professionali, indicando il rapporto professionale dall'arbitro a voi. Dopo aver presentato la tua domanda, riceverai un link di presentazione per inoltrare i tuoi arbitri; le lettere devono essere caricate confidenziali prima della data di chiusura (il caricamento delle lettere è possibile ma scoraggiato).
descriptionByLocale.en:
What you'll do
You will join one of CERN’s experimental physics groups, if selected for this Research Fellowship, to develop and lead your own research programme at the frontier of particle physics. You will work in a highly collaborative and international environment, analysing data, contributing to detector design, construction and/or operations, and engaging in the design, execution and interpretation of physics data analyses. You will also be part of CERN’s vibrant scientific community through seminars, workshops, training activities and collaborative projects.
Your key tasks

• You conduct research in experimental physics within a CERN research group of your choice.

• You contribute to CERN’s experimental physics programme using its large-scale scientific instruments.

• You collaborate with physicists and engineers on studies of particle interactions and related research activities.

• You develop and pursue your research interests within the framework of the Fellowship.
Your profile

• You hold a strong background in experimental particle physics or a closely related field.

• You have research experience aligned with the scientific activities carried out at CERN’s experimental facilities.

• You are motivated to join a research group and contribute to high-impact scientific work.

• You are eager to develop and pursue your own research interests within the Fellowship framework.
Your skills

• You have solid analytical and problem-solving skills in the context of experimental physics.

• You are able to work collaboratively within large, international scientific teams.

• You communicate effectively in a scientific environment, including presenting and discussing research results.

• You can work independently while contributing to shared research objectives and collaborative projects.

• Application Deadline: 01/09/2026 at 23:59 (Geneva Time)

• Ideal start date: 01/02/2027

• Contract duration: Typically 24 months contract. A small number of outstanding candidates will be offered a 36 month fellowship

• Weekly Working Hours: 40

• Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

• Location: Geneva, Switzerland

• Job Reference: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 7004-7425 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria

• You are a national of a  CERN Member State or Associate Member State . Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani and Lithuanian nationals for positions with a 2026 start date, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached. A few exceptions are possible annually.

• By the application deadline, you have a PhD (or will obtain it within six months), and no more than 6 years’ research experience after completion of your PhD degree.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Please note that CERN Staff members are note eligible to apply for a Fellowship.

• This Vacancy Notice is for Experimental Physics. If instead your field is Applied Science and Engineering, orTheoretical Physics. please consult open positions within the programme available on the  Research Fellowship Programme page .

• Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.
You will need these documents to complete your application

• Your CV (English or French)

• A copy of your most relevant diploma or a certificate of achievement from your university (if you don't yet have your paper diploma)

• A one-page statement of research interests highligthing your plans for the research fellowship (maximum 4,000 characters).

• Three recent letters of recommendation (not older than one year at the application deadline) outlining your academic and/or professional achievements, indicating the professional relationship from the referee to you. After submitting your application, you will receive a submission link to forward to your referees; letters must be uploaded confidentially before the closing date (uploading letters yourself is possible but discouraged).
descriptionByLocale.de:
Was du tun wirst
Sie werden einer der experimentellen Physikgruppen des CERN beitreten, wenn Sie für dieses Forschungsstipendium ausgewählt werden, um Ihr eigenes Forschungsprogramm an der Grenze der Teilchenphysik zu entwickeln und zu leiten. Sie arbeiten in einem hochgradig kooperativen und internationalen Umfeld, analysieren Daten, tragen zum Detektordesign, zum Bau und / oder zum Betrieb bei und beteiligen sich an der Gestaltung, Ausführung und Interpretation von physikalischen Datenanalysen. Sie werden auch Teil der lebendigen wissenschaftlichen Gemeinschaft des CERN durch Seminare, Workshops, Schulungsaktivitäten und Kooperationsprojekte sein.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Sie betreiben Forschung in experimenteller Physik in einer CERN-Forschungsgruppe Ihrer Wahl.

• Sie tragen zum experimentellen Physikprogramm des CERN bei, indem Sie seine groß angelegten wissenschaftlichen Instrumente nutzen.

• Sie arbeiten mit Physikern und Ingenieuren an Studien zu Teilchenwechselwirkungen und verwandten Forschungsaktivitäten zusammen.

• Sie entwickeln und verfolgen Ihre Forschungsinteressen im Rahmen des Fellowships.
Dein Profil

• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund in der experimentellen Teilchenphysik oder einem eng verwandten Gebiet.

• Sie haben Forschungserfahrung, die mit den wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten in den experimentellen Einrichtungen des CERN übereinstimmt.

• Sie sind motiviert, einer Forschungsgruppe beizutreten und zu einer wirkungsvollen wissenschaftlichen Arbeit beizutragen.

• Sie sind bestrebt, Ihre eigenen Forschungsinteressen im Rahmen des Fellowship zu entwickeln und zu verfolgen.
Ihre Fähigkeiten

• Sie haben solide analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten im Kontext der experimentellen Physik.

• Sie können in großen, internationalen wissenschaftlichen Teams zusammenarbeiten.

• Sie kommunizieren effektiv in einem wissenschaftlichen Umfeld, einschließlich der Präsentation und Diskussion von Forschungsergebnissen.

• Sie können unabhängig arbeiten und gleichzeitig zu gemeinsamen Forschungszielen und Verbundprojekten beitragen.

• Bewerbungsschluss: 01/09/2026 um 23:59 Uhr (Genfer Zeit)

• Ideales Startdatum: 01/02/2027

• Vertragsdauer: Typischerweise 24 Monate Vertrag. Eine kleine Anzahl von ausstehenden Kandidaten wird ein 36-monatiges Stipendium angeboten.

• Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit: 40

• Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Vollständig vor Ort

• Standort: Genf, Schweiz

• Stellenbeschreibung: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Globale Vorteile

• Ein monatliches Stipendium zwischen 7004-7425 Schweizer Franken pro Monat (steuerfrei), abhängig von Ihrem Abschluss.

• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.

• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss und Reisekosten), abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 36 Monate zu verlängern.

• On-the-job und formale Ausbildung einschließlich Sprachunterricht.
Achten Sie darauf, die Förderkriterien zu erfüllen

• Sie sind Staatsangehöriger eines CERN-Mitgliedstaats oder assoziierten Mitgliedstaats. Derzeit können wir keine Anträge von pakistanischen und litauischen Staatsangehörigen auf Stellen mit einem Startdatum für 2026 berücksichtigen, da die in Artikel II.5 des assoziierten Beitrittsabkommens festgelegte Obergrenze erreicht wurde. Einige Ausnahmen sind jährlich möglich.

• Bis zum Bewerbungsschluss haben Sie einen Doktortitel (oder erhalten ihn innerhalb von sechs Monaten) und nicht mehr als 6 Jahre Forschungserfahrung nach Abschluss Ihres PhD-Abschlusses.

• Sie hatten noch nie einen CERN-Stipendiaten- oder Absolventenvertrag.

• Bitte beachten Sie, dass Mitglieder des CERN-Personals berechtigt sind, sich für ein Fellowship zu bewerben.

• Diese Vacancy Notice ist für Experimentelle Physik. Wenn stattdessen Ihr Feld Applied Science and Engineering oder Theoretische Physik ist. Bitte konsultieren Sie offene Stellen innerhalb des Programms, die auf der Seite des Forschungsstipendiums verfügbar sind.

• Bitte beachten Sie die zusätzlichen Kriterien und Anforderungen für diese spezifische Position und oben erwähnt.
Sie benötigen diese Dokumente, um Ihre Bewerbung abzuschließen

• Ihr Lebenslauf (Englisch oder Französisch)

• Eine Kopie Ihres wichtigsten Diploms oder eine Leistungsbescheinigung Ihrer Universität (falls Sie noch kein Papierdiplom haben)

• Eine einseitige Erklärung der Forschungsinteressen, die Ihre Pläne für das Forschungsstipendium hochhält (maximal 4.000 Zeichen).

• Drei aktuelle Empfehlungsschreiben (nicht älter als ein Jahr zum Bewerbungsschluss), in denen Ihre akademischen und / oder beruflichen Leistungen dargelegt werden und die berufliche Beziehung des Schiedsrichters zu Ihnen angegeben wird. Nachdem Sie Ihre Bewerbung eingereicht haben, erhalten Sie einen Einreichungslink zur Weiterleitung an Ihre Schiedsrichter; Briefe müssen vor dem Abschlussdatum vertraulich hochgeladen werden (das Hochladen von Briefen selbst ist möglich, aber entmutigt).
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce que tu vas faire
Vous rejoindrez l'un des groupes de physique expérimentale du CERN, s'il est sélectionné pour cette bourse de recherche, pour développer et diriger votre propre programme de recherche à la frontière de la physique des particules. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement hautement collaboratif et international, en analysant les données, en contribuant à la conception, à la construction et/ou aux opérations des détecteurs, et en participant à la conception, à l'exécution et à l'interprétation des analyses de données physiques. Vous ferez également partie de la communauté scientifique dynamique du CERN à travers des séminaires, des ateliers, des activités de formation et des projets collaboratifs.
Vos tâches clés

• Vous effectuez des recherches en physique expérimentale au sein d'un groupe de recherche du CERN de votre choix.

• Vous contribuez au programme de physique expérimentale du CERN en utilisant ses instruments scientifiques à grande échelle.

• Vous collaborez avec des physiciens et des ingénieurs à des études sur les interactions des particules et les activités de recherche connexes.

• Vous développez et poursuivez vos intérêts de recherche dans le cadre de la Bourse.
Votre profil

• Vous avez une solide formation en physique expérimentale des particules ou un domaine étroitement lié.

• Vous avez une expérience de recherche alignée sur les activités scientifiques menées dans les installations expérimentales du CERN.

• Vous êtes motivé à rejoindre un groupe de recherche et à contribuer à des travaux scientifiques à haut impact.

• Vous êtes impatient de développer et de poursuivre vos propres intérêts de recherche dans le cadre de la Bourse.
Vos compétences

• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes dans le contexte de la physique expérimentale.

• Vous pouvez travailler en collaboration au sein de grandes équipes scientifiques internationales.

• Vous communiquez efficacement dans un environnement scientifique, notamment en présentant et en discutant des résultats de recherche.

• Vous pouvez travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant à des objectifs de recherche communs et à des projets collaboratifs.

• Date limite de présentation des demandes: 01/09/2026 à 23:59 (heure de Genève)

• Date de début idéale: 01/02/2027

• Durée du contrat : Généralement 24 mois. Un petit nombre de candidats exceptionnels recevront une bourse de 36 mois

• Heures de travail hebdomadaires: 40

• Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place

• Lieu: Genève, Suisse

• Référence emploi: EP-2026-1/Cat1

Avantages globaux

• Une allocation mensuelle entre 7004-7425 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.

• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.

• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.

• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.

• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues.
Assurez-vous de satisfaire aux critères d'admissibilité

• Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre du CERN ou d'un État membre associé . À l'heure actuelle, nous ne pouvons pas examiner les demandes de ressortissants pakistanais et lituaniens pour des postes dont la date de début est 2026, car le plafond défini à l'article II.5 de l'Accord d'adhésion associé a été atteint. Quelques exceptions sont possibles chaque année.

• D'ici la date limite, vous avez un doctorat (ou l'obtiendrez dans les six mois) et pas plus de 6 ans d'expérience de recherche après avoir terminé votre doctorat.

• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures.

• Veuillez noter que les fonctionnaires du CERN peuvent postuler à une bourse.

• Cet avis de vacance est pour la physique expérimentale. Si votre domaine est la science appliquée et l'ingénierie, ou la physique théorique. consulter les positions ouvertes dans le cadre du programme disponibles sur la page Programme de bourses de recherche .

• Veuillez prêter attention aux critères et exigences supplémentaires pour ce poste spécifique et mentionnés ci-dessus.
Vous aurez besoin de ces documents pour compléter votre demande

• Votre CV (anglais ou français)

• Une copie de votre diplôme le plus pertinent ou un certificat de réussite de votre université (si vous n'avez pas encore votre diplôme sur papier)

• Un énoncé de recherche d'une page vous intéresse à donner des conseils pour la bourse de recherche (maximum 4 000 caractères).

• Trois récentes lettres de recommandation (pas plus d'un an à la date limite de présentation des demandes) décrivant vos réalisations scolaires et/ou professionnelles, indiquant la relation professionnelle entre le répondant et vous. Après avoir soumis votre demande, vous recevrez un lien de soumission à transmettre à vos répondants; les lettres doivent être téléchargées de façon confidentielle avant la date de clôture (le téléchargement des lettres vous-même est possible mais découragé).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Il Gruppo di Ingegneria Elettrica (EN-EL) del CERN è responsabile della rete elettrica di distribuzione (da 400 kV a 400/230V), dell'infrastruttura a fibre ottiche e del cablaggio di segnale e potenza CC per il complesso dell'acceleratore. Vi unirete all'Ufficio di Progettazione e Documentazione Elettrica (EN-EL-DDO) come progettista elettrico.

Lavorando sotto la guida di senior design manager, contribuirete a diversi progetti strategici del CERN, tra cui il consolidamento elettrico della North Area, le sottostazioni elettriche SPS LV e il rinnovamento di relè di protezione a media tensione obsoleti nell'LHC. Con il supporto di un senior designer, farete la progettazione di reti di distribuzione a bassa tensione, apparecchiature che si chiudono, studi di protezione e studi di illuminazione con l'obiettivo di intraprendere progetti di crescente complessità.

Le vostre responsabilità

Ci si aspetta di possedere le conoscenze fondamentali necessarie per:

- Eseguire calcoli a corto circuito. - Condurre studi di coordinamento e selettività della protezione. - Progettare sistemi di distribuzione elettrica e circuiti. - Preparare rapporti di calcolo, studi di illuminazione e studi di messa a terra. - Produrre disegni di progettazione elettrica, compresi diagrammi di linea. - Preparare fatture dei materiali per apparecchiature elettriche e installazioni. Maggiori informazioni qui.

Il tuo profilo

- L'esperienza di Proven nella progettazione di reti di distribuzione a bassa tensione (note di calcolo LV, dimensionamento delle apparecchiature, studi di selettività e protezione). - L'esperienza di Proven nei calcoli a corto circuito. - L'esperienza di Proven negli studi di selettività. - L'esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi di illuminazione per edifici ed aree esterne che utilizzano DIALux è vantaggiosa per il ruolo. - L'esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi secondari con E-PLAN o software simile è vantaggiosa per il ruolo. - L'esperienza nella progettazione di reti di distribuzione a media tensione è vantaggiosa per il ruolo.

Competenze

Capacità e conoscenze richieste:

- Conoscenza degli standard LV, protezione LV, protezione indiretta dei contatti, conoscenza dei diversi tipi di sistemi di terra e reti di sicurezza. - Buona comprensione dei sistemi di alimentazione; calcolo della caduta di tensione, calcoli dei cortocircuiti e dimensionamento di cavi e apparecchiature. - Esperienza con strumenti di calcolo della progettazione a bassa tensione (ElecCalc, Caneco o software simile). - Proficienza in AutoCAD o simili.

Capacità linguistiche:

- Spoken e scritto inglese, con l'impegno di imparare il francese.

Criteri di ammissibilità:

- Hai una formazione professionale in Ingegneria Elettrica (o un campo correlato) e hai: - un master con 2-6 anni di esperienza professionale post-laurea; - o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-laurea. - Non hai mai avuto un compagno CERN o un contratto di laurea prima.

Informazioni supplementari

- Data di chiusura del lavoro: 26.07.2026 alle 23:59 CEST. - Durata del contratto: 24 mesi, con una possibile estensione fino a 36 mesi massimo. - Flessibilità del lavoro: Completamente Onsite - Data di inizio dell'obiettivo: 01-Settembre-2026 - Questa posizione comprende: - Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione. - Interventi in impianti sotterranei. - Una patente di guida valida. - Riferimento del lavoro: EN-EL-DDO-2026-104-GRAP - Campo di lavoro: Elettronica o Elettronica Ingegneria - Benchmark job: 200030 - Ingegnere elettrico

Benefici globali

- Un mensile di 63627-7004 franchi svizzeri al mese (tassa gratuita) a seconda del grado. - 30 giorni di ferie retribuite all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale. - Copertura da parte del CERN.s regime di assicurazione sanitaria completa (per te, il tuo coniuge ei figli), e l'iscrizione al fondo pensione CERN. - Assegni mensili per famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali. - Un pacchetto di ricollocazione (concessione di installazione e spese di viaggio) a seconda delle circostanze individuali. - Sovvenzione di estendere il contratto fino a 36 mesi.

- Formazione professionale e formale, comprese lezioni di lingua.

Informazioni sul CERN

Scoprite un mondo dove l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione Europea per la Ricerca Nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo fisici ma anche una gamma di professionisti diversificati provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, sviluppiamo un ambiente dove l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno, affrontiamo nuove sfide e opportunità emozionanti per contribuire a una ricerca all'avanguardia che modella la nostra comprensione dell'universo.

Affrontiamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia apprezzato e guidando il nostro comune senso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e per il nostro continuo successo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, CERN è il luogo dove la vostra curiosità e le vostre abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire ciò che è al centro dell'universo!
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Electrical Engineering Group (EN-EL) at CERN is responsible for the electrical power-distribution network (from 400 kV to 400/230V), for the fibre-optics infrastructure, and for signal and DC-power cabling for the accelerator complex.
You will join the Electrical Design and Documentation Office (EN-EL-DDO) as an Electrical Designer. Working under the guidance of senior design managers, you will contribute to several strategic CERN projects, including the electrical consolidation of the North Area, SPS LV electrical substations and the renovation of obsolete medium-voltage protection relays in the LHC.
With the support of a senior designer, you will do the design of low voltage distribution networks, equipment sizing, protection studies and lighting studies with the objective of taking on projects of increasing complexity.
Your responsibilities
You are expected to possess the foundational knowledge required to:

• Perform short-circuit calculations.

• Conduct protection coordination and selectivity studies.

• Design electrical power distribution systems and circuits.

• Prepare calculation reports, lighting studies, and earthing studies.

• Produce electrical design drawings, including single-line diagrams.

• Prepare bills of materials for electrical equipment and installations.
More information here .
Your profile

Die Electrical Engineering Group (EN-EL) am CERN ist für das elektrische Leistungsverteilungsnetz (von 400 kV bis 400/230V), die Glasfaserinfrastruktur sowie für Signal- und DC-Leistungsverkabelung für den Beschleunigerkomplex zuständig. Sie treten als Elektrodesigner in das Büro für Elektrokonstruktion und Dokumentation (EN-EL-DDO) ein.

Unter der Leitung von Senior Design Managern werden Sie zu mehreren strategischen CERN-Projekten beitragen, darunter die elektrische Konsolidierung des Nordgebiets, die SPS LV-Umspannwerke und die Sanierung veralteter Mittelspannungsschutzrelais im LHC. Mit Unterstützung eines Senior Designers werden Sie die Planung von Niederspannungsverteilungsnetzen, Geräte-Sizing, Schutzstudien und Lichtstudien mit dem Ziel durchführen, Projekte mit zunehmender Komplexität zu übernehmen.

Ihre Verantwortung

Sie werden erwartet, dass Sie das Grundwissen besitzen, das erforderlich ist, um:

- Durchführung von Kurzschlussberechnungen. - Durchführung von Untersuchungen zur Koordination und Selektivität des Schutzes. - Entwurf elektrischer Stromverteilungssysteme und Stromkreise. - Erstellung von Berechnungsberichten, Beleuchtungsstudien und Erdungsstudien. - Produzieren elektrischer Konstruktionszeichnungen, einschließlich einzeiliger Diagramme. - Erstellung von Materialrechnungen für elektrische Geräte und Anlagen. Mehr Informationen hier.

- Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Lichtsystemen für Gebäude und Außenflächen mit DIALux ist von Vorteil. - Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Sekundärsystemen mit E-PLAN oder ähnlicher Software ist von Vorteil für die Rolle. - Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Mittelspannungsverteilungsnetzen ist von Vorteil für die Rolle. - Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von Kleinspannungsverteilungsnetzen.

Kompetenzen

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse:

- Kenntnisse der LV-Standards, LV-Schutz, indirekter Kontaktschutz, Kenntnisse der verschiedenen Arten von Erdungs- und Sicherheitsnetzen. - Ein gutes Verständnis von Stromversorgungssystemen; Spannungsabfallberechnungen, Kurzschlussberechnungen und Dimensionierung von Kabeln und Geräten. - Erfahrung mit Niederspannungs-Design-Berechnungswerkzeugen (ElecCalc, Caneco oder ähnliche Software). - Kompetenz in AutoCAD oder ähnlichem.

- Spoken und geschriebenes Englisch, mit der Verpflichtung, Französisch zu lernen.

Désignation des marchandises

Le Groupe de l'ingénierie électrique (EN-EL) du CERN est responsable du réseau de distribution de puissance électrique (de 400 kV à 400/230V), de l'infrastructure fibre optique et du câblage de signal et de courant continu pour le complexe d'accélérateur. Vous rejoindrez le Bureau de la conception et de la documentation électriques (EN-EL-DDO) en tant que concepteur électrique.

En travaillant sous la direction de responsables de conception, vous contribuerez à plusieurs projets stratégiques du CERN, dont la consolidation électrique de la zone Nord, les sous-stations électriques SPS LV et la rénovation de relais de protection contre les gaz à moyenne-énergie obsolètes dans la LHC. Avec le soutien d'un concepteur senior, vous réaliserez la conception de réseaux de distribution basse tension, de dimensionnement des équipements, d'études de protection et d'études d'éclairage dans le but de prendre en charge des projets de complexité croissante.

Vos responsabilités

Vous devez posséder les connaissances fondamentales nécessaires pour :

- Effectuer des calculs courts-circuits. - Effectuer des études de coordination de la protection et de sélectivité. - Concevoir des systèmes et des circuits de distribution de l'énergie électrique. - Préparer des rapports de calcul, des études d'éclairage et des études de mise à la terre. - Produire des dessins de conception électrique, y compris des diagrammes à une ligne. - Préparer des factures de matériaux pour les équipements et installations électriques.

Votre profil

- Expérience pratique dans la conception de réseaux de distribution basse tension (notes de calcul VV, dimensionnement des équipements, études de sélectivité et protection). - Expérience pratique dans le calcul de courts-circuits. - Expérience pratique dans les études de sélectivité. - Expérience dans la conception de systèmes d'éclairage pour bâtiments et zones extérieures utilisant DIALux est bénéfique pour le rôle. - Expérience dans la conception de systèmes secondaires avec E-PLAN ou un logiciel similaire est bénéfique pour le rôle. - Expérience dans la conception de réseaux de distribution moyenne tension est bénéfique pour le rôle.

Compétences

Compétences et connaissances requises :

- Connaissance des normes LV, protection LV, protection contre les contacts indirects, connaissance des différents types de systèmes de mise à la terre et des réseaux de sécurité. - Bonne compréhension des systèmes de puissance; calculs de chute de tension, calculs de court-circuit et dimensionnement des câbles et des équipements. - Expérience avec les outils de calcul de basse tension (ElecCalc, Caneco ou logiciels similaires). - Compétence en AutoCAD ou similaire.

Compétences linguistiques:

- Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement pour apprendre le français.

Critères d'admissibilité:

- Vous avez une formation professionnelle en génie électrique (ou un domaine connexe) et avez : - une maîtrise avec 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle post-grade ; - ou un doctorat avec pas plus de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle post-grade. - Vous n'avez jamais eu de boursier du CERN ou de contrat de fin d'études avant.

Informations complémentaires

- Date de clôture de l'emploi : 26.07.2026 à 23:59 CEST. - Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec une prolongation possible jusqu'à 36 mois maximum. - Flexibilité de l'emploi : Entièrement sur place - Date de début de l'objectif : 01-Septembre-2026 - Ce poste comprend : - Travail dans les zones de rayonnement. - Interventions dans les installations souterraines. - Permis de conduire valide. - Référence de l'emploi : EN-EL-DDO-2026-104-GRAP - Domaine de travail : Génie électrique ou électronique - Travail de référence : 200030 - Ingénieur en électricité

Avantages globaux

- Une allocation mensuelle comprise entre 6372-004 francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme. - 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle. - Couverture par le CERN, régime d'assurance maladie complet (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants), et adhésion à la Caisse de retraite du CERN. - Allocations mensuelles familiales, infantiles et infantiles selon votre situation individuelle. - Un forfait de réinstallation (allocation d'installation et frais de voyage) selon votre situation individuelle. - Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.

- Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues.

À propos du CERN

Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est possible! Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens mais aussi des professionnels divers des domaines de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent.

Nous répondons à ces défis par les différentes perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et en stimulant notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les frontières du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer.

Il lavoro prevede la progettazione di grandi solenoidi superconduttori che generano forti campi magnetici per aiutare a identificare e misurare le particelle prodotte in collisioni elettroni-positrone. Le responsabilità includono studi analitici e finiti di avvolgimento dei magneti, tra cui il comportamento termico, il raffreddamento criogenico e le prestazioni meccaniche. Il ruolo include anche il supporto del direttore R&D attraverso studi e prototipazione di superconduttori a bassa e alta temperatura. Ulteriori attività comportano la produzione, il test e la caratterizzazione di campioni di conduttori per le loro proprietà superconduttive, termiche, elettriche e meccaniche. Le tue responsabilità:
• Condurre studi concettuali e finiti di magneti rivelatori superconduttori, tra cui geometria di massa fredda, comportamento termico, raffreddamento criogenico e prestazioni meccaniche.
• Supporta la progettazione e l'ottimizzazione di sistemi magneti superconduttori per future applicazioni di rilevatori di particelle.
• Partecipa alle attività di direttore R&D che coinvolgono superconduttori a bassa temperatura e ad alta temperatura.
• Assistere con prototipazione del conduttore, produzione dimostrativa e campagne di test sperimentali.
• Caratterizzare i campioni del conduttore valutando le loro proprietà superconduttive, termiche, elettriche e meccaniche.

• Sfondo in superconduttività e tecnologie superconduttive.
• Esperienza con design magnete superconduttore e studi di superconduttore.
• Conoscenza delle tecniche di scienza e caratterizzazione dei materiali.
• Familiarità con fisica sperimentale e sistemi criogenici.
• Esperienza con metodi di analisi analitici e finiti. Competenze:
• Capacità di analisi degli elementi finiti utilizzando software commerciali come Ansys e COMSOL.

descriptionByLocale.en:
This project focuses on the conceptual designs and conductor studies for large superconducting detector magnets planned for the Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) at CERN, the proposed successor to the Large Hadron Collider.
The work involves designing large superconducting solenoids that generate strong magnetic fields to help identify and measure particles produced in electron-positron collisions.
Responsibilities include analytical and finite-element studies of magnet windings, including thermal behavior, cryogenic cooling, and mechanical performance.
The role also includes supporting conductor R&D through studies and prototyping of low- and high-temperature superconductors. Additional tasks involve manufacturing, testing and characterising conductor samples for their superconducting, thermal, electrical, and mechanical properties.
Your responsibilities:

• Conduct conceptual and finite-element studies of superconducting detector magnets, including cold mass geometry, thermal behaviour, cryogenic cooling, and mechanical performance.

• Support the design and optimisation of superconducting magnet systems for future particle detector applications.

• Participate in conductor R&D activities involving both low-temperature and high-temperature superconductors.

• Assist with conductor prototyping, demonstrator manufacturing, and experimental testing campaigns.

• Characterise conductor samples by evaluating their superconducting, thermal, electrical, and mechanical properties.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.
Your profile:

• Background in superconductivity and superconducting technologies.

• Experience with superconducting magnet design and superconductor studies.

• Knowledge of materials science and characterisation techniques.

• Familiarity with experimental physics and cryogenic systems.

• Experience with analytical and finite-element analysis methods.
Skills:

• Finite element analysis skills using commercial software such as Ansys and COMSOL.

• Capability to conduct experimental superconductivity campaigns, including cryogenic handling, operation of superconducting magnets, preparation of experimental setups, and execution of measurement techniques.

• Knowledge of superconducting conductor technologies, including mechanical properties and microstructural/morphological characterisation.

• Effective collaboration in multidisciplinary team environments.

• Independent work and autonomous management of tasks.

• Ability to present and document the outcome of studies

• Ability to supervise students or junior contributors.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 23.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-CMS-IC-2026-99-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

Dieses Projekt konzentriert sich auf die konzeptionellen Entwürfe und Leiterstudien für große supraleitende Detektormagnete, die für den Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) am CERN, dem vorgeschlagenen Nachfolger des Large Hadron Collider, geplant sind. Die Arbeit umfasst die Entwicklung großer supraleitender Magnete, die starke Magnetfelder erzeugen, um Partikel zu identifizieren und zu messen, die bei Elektronen-Positronen-Kollisionen erzeugt werden. Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören analytische und Finite-Elemente-Untersuchungen von Magnetwicklungen, einschließlich des thermischen Verhaltens, der kryogenen Kühlung und der mechanischen Leistung. Weitere Aufgaben umfassen die Herstellung, Prüfung und Charakterisierung von Leiterproben auf ihre supraleitenden, thermischen, elektrischen und mechanischen Eigenschaften. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Durchführung konzeptioneller und Finite-Elemente-Untersuchungen von supraleitenden Detektormagneten, einschließlich Kaltmassengeometrie, thermischem Verhalten, kryogener Kühlung und mechanischer Leistung.

Ce projet met l'accent sur les conceptions conceptuelles et les études de conducteurs de gros aimants de détecteur supraconducteurs prévus pour le futur collisionneur circulaire (FCC-ee) au CERN, le successeur proposé du grand collisionneur à hadron. Le travail consiste à concevoir de grands solénoïdes supraconducteurs qui génèrent des champs magnétiques puissants pour aider à identifier et mesurer les particules produites dans les collisions électro-positrons. Les responsabilités comprennent des études analytiques et à éléments finis des enroulements magnétiques, y compris le comportement thermique, le refroidissement cryogénique et les performances mécaniques. Le rôle consiste également à appuyer la R-D des conducteurs par des études et des prototypages de supraconducteurs à basse et haute température. D'autres tâches comprennent la fabrication, l'essai et la caractérisation d'échantillons de conducteurs pour leurs propriétés supraconductrices, thermiques, électriques et mécaniques. Vos responsabilités :
• Effectuer des études conceptuelles et à éléments finis des aimants de détecteur supraconducteurs, y compris la géométrie de la masse froide, le comportement thermique, le refroidissement cryogénique et les performances mécaniques.
• Soutenir la conception et l'optimisation de systèmes d'aimants supraconducteurs pour les applications futures de détecteurs de particules.
• Participer aux activités de R-D des conducteurs comportant des supraconducteurs à basse température et à haute température.
• Aider au prototypage des conducteurs, à la fabrication des démonstrateurs et aux campagnes expérimentales d'essais.
• Caractériser les échantillons de conducteurs en évaluant leurs propriétés supraconductrices, thermiques, électriques et mécaniques.
• Ce rôle comprend les responsabilités de supervision de l'équipe. Votre profil:
• Contexte de la supraconductivité et des technologies supraconductrices.
• Expérience de la conception d'aimants supraconducteurs et études de supraconducteurs.
• Connaissance des sciences des matériaux et des techniques de caractérisation.
• Connaissance de la physique expérimentale et des systèmes cryogéniques.
• Expérience des méthodes d'analyse et d'analyse des éléments finis. Compétences :
• Compétences en analyse d'éléments finis à l'aide de logiciels commerciaux comme Ansys et COMSOL.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Come and join the cryogenics maintenance team within the Technology Department ( TE ), specifically within the Maintenance Methods and Logistics section. We're offering a unique opportunity to work and contribute to the preparation of the next maintenance technical shutdown and integration of new major assets in the maintenance systems.
 CERN is the world's largest particle physics laboratory and its flagship accelerator, the Large Hadron Collider, depends on having an unrivalled set of cryogenic systems on hand to guarantee reliable operation.
 Typical cryogenic systems comprise compressors, heat exchangers, valves, instrumentation, vacuum pumps, controls and various test benches for cables, magnets and RF cavities. Process gas purity is essential.
 The experience you will gain as a member of the cryogenics maintenance team could not be acquired anywhere else, teaching you to work autonomously and address maintenance solution to large and complex systems. Be part of a team overseeing the organisation of Long Shutdown 3 for the cryogenics infrastructure and provide your input.
 Your responsibilities:

• Collecting and consolidating maintenance data within the Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) - Supporting the preparation and coordination of maintenance activities on-site.

• Rolling out new maintenance methodologies in collaboration with field technicians.

• Enhancing work instructions, checklists, and quality assurance procedures used by contractors.

• Contributing to the implementation of maintenance policies and best practices for new cryogenic assets as part of the HL-LHC (High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider) project.
 Take this opportunity to work on one of the most advanced cryogenic systems in the world and make your mark on a project of global scientific importance.
 More information here: https://te-dep-crg-ml.web.cern.ch/
 Your profile:

• Basic mechanical and electrical skills.

• Experience using Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

• Knowledge of cryogenics fundamentals or oil and gas systems would be an advantage.

• Ability to read technical drawings.

• Understanding of maintenance documentation.

• Demonstrated teamwork, safety awareness, and problem-solving.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Skills:

• Good teamwork and communication skills.

• Strong safety awareness and willingness to follow established procedures.

• Motivation to learn and develop new technical competencies.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
 Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 28.08.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
 Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
 Job reference: TE-CRG-ML-2026-194-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vieni a far parte del team di manutenzione criogenica all'interno del Dipartimento Tecnologico ( TE), in particolare all'interno della sezione Metodi di Manutenzione e Logistica. Stiamo offrendo un'occasione unica per lavorare e contribuire alla preparazione del prossimo arresto tecnico manutenzione e integrazione di nuovi asset principali nei sistemi di manutenzione.
 Il CERN è il più grande laboratorio di fisica delle particelle al mondo e il suo acceleratore di punta, il Large Hadron Collider, dipende dall'avere una serie senza rivali di sistemi criogenici a disposizione per garantire un funzionamento affidabile.
 Tipici sistemi criogenici comprendono compressori, scambiatori di calore, valvole, strumentazione, pompe di vuoto, controlli e vari banchi di prova per cavi, magneti e cavità RF. La purezza del gas di processo è essenziale.
 L'esperienza che otterrete come membro del team di manutenzione criogenica non potrebbe essere acquisita altrove, insegnando a lavorare autonomamente e affrontare la soluzione di manutenzione a sistemi grandi e complessi. Fai parte di un team che supervisiona l'organizzazione di Long Shutdown 3 per l'infrastruttura criogenica e fornisce il tuo contributo.
 Le tue responsabilità:

• Raccogliere e consolidare i dati di manutenzione all'interno del sistema di gestione della manutenzione informatizzata (CMMS) - Sostenere la preparazione e il coordinamento delle attività di manutenzione in loco.

• Elaborazione di nuove metodologie di manutenzione in collaborazione con i tecnici del settore.

• Migliorare le istruzioni di lavoro, le liste di controllo e le procedure di garanzia della qualità utilizzate dai contraenti.

• Contribuire alla realizzazione di politiche di manutenzione e best practice per nuovi asset criogenici nell'ambito del progetto HL-LHC (High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider).
 Cogliete questa opportunità di lavorare su uno dei sistemi criogenici più avanzati del mondo e fate il vostro segno su un progetto di importanza scientifica globale.
 Ulteriori informazioni qui: https://te-dep-crg-ml.web.cern.ch/
 Il tuo profilo:

• Capacità meccaniche ed elettriche di base.

• Esperienza utilizzando il sistema di gestione della manutenzione computerizzata (CMMS).

• La conoscenza dei fondamenti criogenici o dei sistemi di petrolio e gas sarebbe un vantaggio.

• Capacità di leggere disegni tecnici.

• Comprensione della documentazione di manutenzione.

• Lavoro di squadra dimostrata, consapevolezza della sicurezza e problem solving.

• Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.
 Competenze:

• Buon lavoro di squadra e capacità di comunicazione.

• Forte consapevolezza della sicurezza e disponibilità a seguire procedure consolidate.

• Motivazione per imparare e sviluppare nuove competenze tecniche.

• Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua.
 Criteri di ammissibilità:

descriptionByLocale.de:
Treten Sie dem Kryotechnik-Wartungsteam innerhalb der Technologieabteilung (TE) bei, insbesondere im Bereich Wartungsmethoden und Logistik. Wir bieten eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Vorbereitung der nächsten technischen Wartungsabschaltung und der Integration neuer wichtiger Anlagen in die Wartungssysteme zu arbeiten und dazu beizutragen.
 CERN ist das weltweit größte Labor für Teilchenphysik und sein Flaggschiff-Beschleuniger, der Large Hadron Collider, hängt davon ab, dass ein unvergleichlicher Satz kryogener Systeme zur Verfügung steht, um einen zuverlässigen Betrieb zu gewährleisten.
 Typische kryogene Systeme umfassen Kompressoren, Wärmetauscher, Ventile, Messgeräte, Vakuumpumpen, Steuerungen und verschiedene Prüfstände für Kabel, Magnete und HF-Hohlräume. Die Reinheit des Prozessgases ist unerlässlich.
 Die Erfahrung, die Sie als Mitglied des Kryotechnik-Wartungsteams sammeln, kann nirgendwo anders erworben werden und lehrt Sie, autonom zu arbeiten und Wartungslösungen für große und komplexe Systeme zu adressieren. Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das die Organisation von Long Shutdown 3 für die Kryotechnik-Infrastruktur überwacht und Ihren Input liefert.
 Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sammeln und Konsolidieren von Wartungsdaten im Rahmen des Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) - Unterstützung der Vorbereitung und Koordination von Wartungsaktivitäten vor Ort.

• Einführung neuer Wartungsmethoden in Zusammenarbeit mit Außendiensttechnikern.

• Verbesserung von Arbeitsanweisungen, Checklisten und Qualitätssicherungsverfahren, die von Auftragnehmern verwendet werden.

• Beitrag zur Umsetzung von Wartungsrichtlinien und Best Practices für neue kryogene Anlagen im Rahmen des Projekts HL-LHC (High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider).
 Nutzen Sie diese Gelegenheit, um an einem der fortschrittlichsten kryogenen Systeme der Welt zu arbeiten und ein Projekt von globaler wissenschaftlicher Bedeutung zu prägen.
 Weitere Informationen finden Sie hier: https://te-dep-crg-ml.web.cern.ch/
 Ihr Profil:

• Grundlegende mechanische und elektrische Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung mit Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

• Kenntnisse über kryogene Grundlagen oder Öl- und Gassysteme wären von Vorteil.

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen zu lesen.

• Verständnis der Instandhaltungsdokumentation.

• Demonstrierte Teamarbeit, Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Problemlösung.

• Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.
 Fähigkeiten:

• Gute Teamarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Starkes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und Bereitschaft, etablierte Verfahren zu befolgen.

• Motivation zu lernen und neue technische Kompetenzen zu entwickeln.

• Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen.
 Förderkriterien:

descriptionByLocale.en:
RADNEXT 2030  is a Horizon Europe Research Infrastructure Services project that provides coordinated transnational access to radiation effects testing facilities across Europe and beyond. CERN is the project coordinator and also operates two key facilities within the network: CHARM and HEARTS@CERN .
This position is embedded in the Radiation to Electronics (R2E) activity within the Accelerator Systems department. You will work at the interface between project management, user access operations, and radiation effects research, contributing to the successful delivery of RADNEXT 2030's objectives.
You will gain broad exposure to the European radiation hardness assurance community, to CERN's accelerator infrastructure, and to the design, execution and analysis of radiation effects experiments.
Your responsibilities:

• Work on the definition and coordination of the transnational access workflow for facilities within the RADNEXT 2030 framework.

• Contribute to the definition, testing and improvement of the facility access online portal.

• Provide scientific support to the organisation and delivery of RADNEXT 2030 consortium activities.

• Support the scientific communication, dissemination and outreach activities of RADNEXT 2030.

• Contribute to applied research tasks, with a focus on novel beam techniques and radiation environment characterisation, in particular fragmented heavy-ion beams for full LET-spectrum testing and pulsed-electron SEE proxy studies.

• Support the integration of the HEARTS@CERN facility and its related user management into the RADNEXT 2030 consortium.

• Engage with the broader radiation effects community through the RADNEXT 2030 user base, supporting training activities including the Radiation Effects Testing Summer School.
Your profile:

• Experience in radiation effects testing and radiation hardness assurance.

• Experience in the design, preparation and execution of irradiation experiments.

• Experience in scientific writing and dissemination (publications, reports, conference contributions).

• Familiarity with project coordination, user support or scientific service activities would be an advantage.
Skills:

• Knowledge of radiation effects in electronics and of the main radiation test standards and methodologies (e.g. ESA/ECSS, MIL-STD).

• Knowledge of particle accelerator facilities and radiation-matter interaction physics relevant to radiation effects testing.

• Ability to work in an international, multi-institutional project environment and to interact with a diverse user community.

• Strong organisational and communication skills, with ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Applied Physics, Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's Degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 22.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: SY-STI-BMP-2026-118-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an applied physicist, you will contribute to the development of radiation-hard Spaghetti Calorimeter (SpaCal) technology with dense absorbers to achieve picosecond-level time resolutions. This work is part of the strategic detector R&D programme within the Experimental Physics (EP) Department at CERN.
Your responsibilities

• Actively participate in ongoing R&D efforts to develop and optimise Spaghetti Calorimeter (SpaCal) technology for the LHCb PicoCal and other applications.

• Take part in the test-beam and laboratory characterisation of SpaCal prototype modules, with the aim of optimising the time resolution.

• Contribute to studies aimed at optimising photon detectors for SpaCal technology.

• Characterise novel radiation-hard, fast crystal scintillating fibres and organic scintillating materials.

• Document the results in scientific publications.
More information here .
Your profile

• Proven track record in the development of detectors for particle physics experiments.

• Demonstrated experience in calorimeter detector testing, both in the laboratory and in test-beam environments.

• Experience in the characterisation of photon detectors and/or scintillators is an advantage.

• Experience in the simulation of optical calorimeter technologies is an advantage.
Skills

• Understanding of optical calorimeter concepts.

• Practical knowledge of laboratory equipment and data acquisition systems.

• Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary team with physicists, engineers and technicians.

• Knowledge of programming languages such as C++ and Python.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 22.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to lead.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-LCB-2026-126-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
As Mechanical Technician you will contribute to the upgrade project of the electromagnetic calorimeter (ECAL) of the CMS detector at LHC covering a large panel of activities and responsibilities, from mechanical works, handling and assembly of detector parts, logistic activities. You will work in close collaboration with all ECAL collaborators and CMS technical team.
Functions:

• Provide mechanical support for all the ECAL activities.

• Ensure the safe handling of very fragile ECAL detector Supermodules during extraction, insertion and refurbishment .

• Coordinate the logistics of materials and equipment required for ECAL detector refurbishment activities.

• Serve as the technical contact person between CMS experiment site and ECAL refurbishment team.

• Provide technical support for detector maintenance activities, including cooling systems, mechatronic equipment, and instrumentation set-ups.

• Higher Technical Diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanics, Mechatronic or a related field.

• Knowledge of cooling operation and maintenance, experience in logistic coordination.
Experience:

• Reading 2D/3D designs, manufacturing mechanical parts accordingly.

• Design, construction, assembly of mechanical components.

• Detector assembly (including cooling, pressure test, leak detection).

• Handling of large and fragile equipment.

• Working with multidisciplinary teams.
The following experience would be an advantage:

• Experience in producing 2D and 3D drawings.

• Experience of cutting, polishing and assembly of optical material.

• Experience on cabling and soldering.

• Knowledge of applying safety regulations and procedures.
Technical competencies:

• Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.

• Manufacturing of mechanical parts.

• Integration of mechanical systems.

• Operation and maintenance of cooling water systems.

• Operation of handling system.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: delivering prompt and efficient service taking into account customer needs.

• Solving Problems: adopting a pragmatic approach; understanding the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 21.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to lead.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: EP-CMS-LD-2026-138-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können.
