descriptionByLocale.en:
The Event Filter (EF) is part of the ATLAS Trigger and Data Acquisition (TDAQ) system and consists of a multi-threaded asynchronous processing farm of commodity servers (CPUs with or without accelerators) running a subset of offline-like reconstruction algorithms together with menu-driven event selection.
The high-luminosity conditions expected during Phase-II operations introduce significant challenges for object and event reconstruction algorithms planned for the EF, particularly for track reconstruction. The recent definition of the EF farm as a heterogeneous architecture combining CPUs and GPUs opens new opportunities for deploying machine learning models within the EF tracking workflow.
You will be part of the CERN ATLAS team and will contribute to research into the application of ML techniques for track reconstruction at the HL-LHC, with the goal of identifying and exploring the most promising approaches for deployment in the ATLAS EF tracking. The position is part of the Next Generation Trigger programme.
Your responsibilities:

• Conduct research on machine learning (ML) and AI-based approaches for track reconstruction, with a focus on the applicability and performance of these methods in the high pile-up environment of the HL-LHC.

• Investigate and benchmark novel ML-based tracking algorithms and their integration into the ACTS-based EF tracking workflow.

• Contribute to studies of both physics performance and computational performance of the different configurations under study.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.
Your profile:

• Understanding of tracking challenges in high track density environments, such as at the High-Luminosity LHC.

• Experience in the development and application of machine learning or deep learning methods in a physics or scientific computing context.

• Hands-on experience in the development of offline and/or online reconstruction software.

• Ability to lead teams and define directions.
Skills:

• Machine learning and deep learning frameworks.

• Experience with ML inference deployment.

• Knowledge of ML model training, evaluation, and optimisation, including hyperparameter tuning and performance benchmarking.

• Programming languages: C++ and Python, including software development workflows (Git, Jira).

• Experience with large-scale scientific software frameworks (e.g. ACTS, Athena) is considered an asset.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You have a professional background in PhD in Particle Physics / CS (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 17.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: EP-ATL-OSW-2026-121-GRAP
Field of work: Experimental Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Der Ereignisfilter (EF) ist Teil des ATLAS-Trigger- und Datenerfassungssystems (TDAQ) und besteht aus einer multi-threaded asynchronen Verarbeitungsfarm von Commodity-Servern (CPUs mit oder ohne Beschleuniger), die eine Teilmenge offline-ähnlicher Rekonstruktionsalgorithmen zusammen mit einer menügesteuerten Ereignisauswahl ausführen. Die während des Phase-II-Betriebs erwarteten Bedingungen mit hoher Leuchtkraft stellen erhebliche Herausforderungen für die für den EF geplanten Algorithmen zur Objekt- und Ereignisrekonstruktion dar, insbesondere für die Gleisrekonstruktion. Die jüngste Definition der EF-Farm als heterogene Architektur, die CPUs und GPUs kombiniert, eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten für die Bereitstellung von Modellen für maschinelles Lernen innerhalb des EF-Tracking-Workflows. • Fähigkeit, Teams zu führen und Richtungen zu definieren. Fähigkeiten:
• Machine Learning und Deep Learning Frameworks.

Le filtre d'événements (EF) fait partie du système ATLAS Trigger and Data Acquisition (TDAQ) et se compose d'une ferme de traitement asynchrone multithreadée de serveurs de marchandises (CPUs avec ou sans accélérateurs) exécutant un sous-ensemble d'algorithmes de reconstruction hors ligne ainsi que la sélection d'événements pilotés par menu. Les conditions de luminosité élevées attendues au cours des opérations de phase II présentent des défis importants pour les algorithmes de reconstruction d'objets et d'événements prévus pour l'EF, en particulier pour la reconstruction des voies. La définition récente de la ferme EF en tant qu'architecture hétérogène combinant les CPU et les GPU ouvre de nouvelles possibilités de déploiement de modèles d'apprentissage automatique dans le cadre du processus de suivi EF. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe du CERN ATLAS et contribuerez à la recherche sur l'application des techniques ML pour la reconstruction des voies au HL-LHC, dans le but d'identifier et d'explorer les approches les plus prometteuses pour le déploiement dans le suivi de l'EF ATLAS. Ce poste fait partie du programme de déclenchement de la prochaine génération. Vos responsabilités :
• Mener des recherches sur l'apprentissage machine (ML) et les approches basées sur l'IA pour la reconstruction des voies, en mettant l'accent sur l'applicabilité et la performance de ces méthodes dans l'environnement de mise en place élevée du HL-LHC.
• Étudier et comparer les nouveaux algorithmes de suivi basés sur la LM et leur intégration dans le flux de travail de suivi de l'EF basé sur l'ACTS.
• Contribuer à l'étude des performances physiques et des performances informatiques des différentes configurations étudiées.
• Ce rôle comprend les responsabilités de supervision de l'équipe. Votre profil:
• Compréhension des défis de suivi dans les environnements à haute densité de piste, comme au LHC à haute luminosité.
• Expérience dans le développement et l'application de méthodes d'apprentissage automatique ou de méthodes d'apprentissage profond dans un contexte de physique ou de calcul scientifique.
• Expérience pratique dans le développement de logiciels de reconstruction hors ligne et/ou en ligne.
• Capacité de diriger des équipes et de définir des orientations. Compétences :
• Apprentissage automatique et cadres d'apprentissage profond.
• Expérience du déploiement de l'inférence ML.
• Connaissance de la formation, de l'évaluation et de l'optimisation des modèles ML, y compris le réglage hyperparamétrique et l'étalonnage des performances.
• Langages de programmation: C++ et Python, y compris les flux de développement de logiciels (Git, Jira).
• L'expérience des cadres logiciels scientifiques à grande échelle (p. ex. ACTS, Athena) est considérée comme un atout.
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Critères d'éligibilité:
• Vous avez une formation professionnelle en Physique des particules / CS (ou un domaine connexe) et avez :
• une maîtrise de 2 à 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme;
• ou d'un doctorat d'une durée maximale de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle après l'obtention du diplôme.
• Vous n'avez jamais eu de CERN ni de contrat d'études supérieures. Date de clôture de l'emploi: 17.07.2026 à 23:59 CEST. Durée du contrat : 24 mois, avec possibilité de prolongation jusqu'à 36 mois maximum. Heures de travail: 40 heures par semaine Flexibilité de l'emploi: Entièrement sur place Date de début prévue : 01 octobre 2026 Cette position implique:
• Obligation de disponibilité, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent.
• Travaillez pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent. Référence de l'emploi: EP-ATL-OSW-2026-121-GRAP Domaine de travail: Physique expérimentale Travail de référence : 200140 - Médecin appliqué Avantages globaux
• Une allocation mensuelle entre 6372-004 Francs suisses par mois (sans impôt) selon votre diplôme.
• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.
• Couverture par le régime général d'assurance maladie du CERN (pour vous-même, votre conjoint et vos enfants) et affiliation à la Caisse de retraite du CERN.
• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.
• Une trousse de réinstallation (subvention d'installation et frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.
• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 36 mois.
• Formation en cours d'emploi et formation formelle, y compris cours de langues. Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible ! Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Faites partie de notre mission de découvrir ce qui est au cœur de l'univers ! S'il vous plaît ! Plus d'informations sur nous, ici: carriers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
In close collaboration with the Archivist, the Archives Assistant and the Data Governance Officer, you will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining records management best practices across CERN, ensuring that information is managed effectively throughout its lifecycle.
Functions

• Coordinate and oversee records management practices across CERN, including the DRO (Departmental Records Officers) network.

• Provide operational support for records management activities (data/metadata processing, quality control, digital migration).

• Establish a records management implementation strategy and related processes and procedures, and contribute to policy development.

• Develop and maintain retention schedules and related processes in collaboration with stakeholders.

• Lead innovation and continuous improvement initiatives in records management, and monitor KPIs.

• Lead apprentices, interns, and colleagues in records management.

• Deliver training and guidance to users and contribute to outreach and service activities.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Records Management, Archival Science or Library & Information Science or a related field.
Proven qualification or formal training in records management, obtained either as part of the above degree programme or as a separate, recognised qualification.
Experience:

• Proven experience in records management within complex, digital environments, preferably in a large organisation or institution.

• In-depth knowledge and use of records management principles, standards, and lifecycle processes.

• Experience with digital records systems and their integration into wider IT ecosystems.

• Hands-on experience in analysing, handling, and improving data/metadata quality.

• Ability to translate policies and requirements into clear, user-oriented procedures.

• Familiarity with relevant tools (e.g. OpenRefine, CMS, AtoM, Invenio) is an asset.

• Experience in advising and engaging stakeholders, communicating clearly with them.
Technical competencies:

• Archiving and records management.

• Customer service.

• Process analysis, definition and improvement.

• Change management.

• Capturing and analysis of requirements for ICT systems.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Communicating Effectively: leveraging support networks across the Organization.

• Creating Vision and Strategic Partnerships: building comprehensive road maps to translate the organisational vision to an operational level; defining and sets direction accordingly.

• Solving Problems: adopting a pragmatic approach; understanding the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.

• Working in Teams: cooperating constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balancing personal goals with team goals.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 16.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: OSI-SIS-AL-2026-131-LD
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark Job Title: Scientific Information Professional

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione All'interno del dipartimento Beam (BE) e del gruppo Accelerator e Beam Physics (ABP), uniscono la sezione Hadron Sources and Linacs (HSL) al CERN come un fisico applicato al piombo che supervisiona la sorgente di ioni Linac3, un ruolo che riunisce più domini fisici accoppiati con dinamiche di trave, tra cui alte tensioni, campi magnetici elevati, riscaldamento al plasma con microonde, la consegna di gas e vapori in radiografia. Garantirete la consegna ad alte prestazioni di travi ioni pesanti, guidando sia le operazioni quotidiane che lo sviluppo tecnico a lungo termine del sistema fornendo travi di particelle per uno dei complessi più unici di acceleratore del mondo, servendo utenti fissi-target e l'LHC. Funzioni
• Coordinate e partecipate alle attività di montaggio e manutenzione della sorgente di ioni Linac3 durante le fermate e gli spegnimenti tecnici per garantire la preparazione al funzionamento ad alta disponibilità.
• Come esperto in carica, commissiona e gestisci la fonte, sintonizzandola con precisione per ottimizzare le prestazioni e la stabilità per Linac3 e gli iniettori a valle, garantendo il rispetto delle specifiche di qualità del fascio per le piste CERN ion e vari test.
• Progettare e implementare soluzioni tecniche per testare e convalidare la produzione di diverse specie ioni richieste per i futuri programmi di fisica.
• Fai parte del team esperto di macchine, contribuendo alle operazioni più ampie del fascio e partecipando alla rotazione del servizio on-call per garantire un funzionamento affidabile dell'iniettore 24/7.
• Supervisore e mentore un team multidisciplinare tra cui fisici, ingegneri, tecnici e studenti.
• Condurre misurazioni avanzate del fascio e analisi dei dati per caratterizzare le prestazioni di Linac3 e identificare le aree di ottimizzazione.
• Contribuisci agli studi di progettazione e all'esecuzione degli aggiornamenti per il complesso di iniettori CERN, concentrandosi sulla tecnologia di sorgente e sul trasporto a basso raggio energetico (LEBT).
• Contribuisci ad altre attività BE-ABP-HSL attraverso la progettazione, le simulazioni e la messa in servizio di linac e sorgenti di hadron presenti e futuri sotto la responsabilità della sezione. Laurea magistrale o dottorato o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo della fisica applicata, ingegneria o un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Esperienza dimostrata del lavoro nella progettazione e/o nel funzionamento di fonti di particelle per acceleratori o in un campo scientifico correlato.
• Esperienza pratica con sorgenti di particelle o altre attrezzature scientifiche simili, tra cui l'uso di materiali diversi per la progettazione e la movimentazione di attrezzature per l'uso di attrezzature nel vuoto.
• Esperienza a mano con attrezzature ad alta tensione o generatori a microonde.
• Esperienza con codici di simulazione multiparticelle per sorgenti e linac. Esperienza con uno o più i seguenti codici sarebbero un bene: IBSIMU , SIMION, TRAVEL, TRACEWIN, PARMTEQ, RF-TRACK.
• Esperienza di tecniche sperimentali e analisi dei dati di misurazione del fascio. Competenze tecniche:
• Simulazione, progettazione e sviluppo delle fonti del fascio.
• Operazione degli acceleratori.
• Analisi e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni di acceleratore.
• Configurazione e attuazione dei sistemi di acquisizione, monitoraggio e controllo dei dati industriali.
• Organizzazione, pianificazione e controllo. Competenze comportamentali:
• Dimostrare la responsabilità: assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni e decisioni.
• Risolvere i problemi: affrontare problemi complessi distruggendoli in componenti gestibili.
• Comunicare efficacemente: fornire presentazioni in modo strutturato e chiaro; regolare lo stile e il contenuto al pubblico; rispondere con calma e fiducia alle domande.
• Conducendo con forza e credibilità: prendere decisioni tempestive che bilanciano l'analisi sistematica con determinazione; trattare con difficoltà in modo tempestivo. Capacità linguistiche: Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 16.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST . descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
Within the Beam department (BE) and the Accelerator and Beam Physics group (ABP), join the Hadron Sources and Linacs section (HSL) at CERN as a lead applied physicist overseeing the Linac3 ion source, a role bringing together multiple physics domains coupled with beam dynamics, including high voltages, high magnetic fields, plasma heating with microwaves, the delivery of gases and vapours into vacuum systems as well as x-ray generation and shielding. You will ensure the high-performance delivery of heavy ion beams, driving both daily operations and long-term technical development of the system providing particle beams for one of the world's most unique accelerator complexes, serving fixed-target users and the LHC.
Functions

• Coordinate and participate in the Linac3 ion source assembly and maintenance activities during technical stops and shutdowns to ensure preparation for high-availability operation.

• As the expert in-charge, commission and operate the source, tuning it precisely to optimise performance and stability for Linac3 and the downstream injectors, ensuring compliance with beam quality specifications for CERN ion runs and various tests.

• Design and implement technical solutions to test and validate the production of different ion species requested for future physics programmes.

• Be part of the machine expert team, contributing to broader beam operations and participating in the on-call service rotation to ensure 24/7 injector reliable operation.

• Supervise and mentor a multidisciplinary team including physicists, engineers, technicians and students.

• Conduct advanced beam measurements and data analysis to characterise Linac3 performance and identify areas for optimisation.

• Contribute to the design studies and execution of upgrades for the CERN ion injector complex, focusing on source technology and low energy beam transport (LEBT).

• Contribute to other BE-ABP-HSL activities through beam dynamics design, simulations and commissioning for present and future hadron linacs and sources under the section’s responsibility.

Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Engineering or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience of work in the design and/or operation of particle sources for accelerators or in a related scientific field.

• Hands-on experience with particle sources or other similar scientific equipment, including the use of different materials for equipment design and handling for equipment use in vacuum.

• Hands-on experience with high-voltage equipment or microwave generators.

• Experience with multi-particle simulation codes for sources and linacs. Experience with one or more the following codes would be an asset: IBSIMU , SIMION, TRAVEL, TRACEWIN, PARMTEQ, RF-TRACK.

• Experience of experimental techniques and analysis of beam measurements data.
Technical competencies:

• Simulation, design and development of beam sources.

• Operation of accelerators.

• Analysis and optimisation of accelerator performance.

• Configuration and implementation of industrial data-acquisition, monitoring and control systems.

• Organisation, planning and control.
Behavioural competencies:

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.

• Solving Problems: addressing complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.

• Communicating Effectively: delivering presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusting style and content to the audience; responding calmly and confidently to questions.

• Leading with Strength and Credibility: making timely decisions that balance systematic analysis with decisiveness; dealing with difficulties in a timely manner.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 16.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Exposure to lead.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: BE-ABP-HSL-2026-133-LD
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark Job Title: Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

• Beitrag zu den Entwurfsstudien und der Durchführung von Upgrades für den CERN-Ioneninjektorkomplex, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf Quelltechnologie und Niedrigenergiestrahltransport (LEBT) liegt.

Vous assurerez la livraison haute performance des faisceaux ioniques lourds, conduisant à la fois au fonctionnement quotidien et au développement technique à long terme du système fournissant des faisceaux de particules pour l'un des complexes d'accélérateur les plus uniques au monde, au service des utilisateurs à cible fixe et du LHC. Fonctions
• Coordonner et participer aux activités d'assemblage et d'entretien des sources d'ions Linac3 pendant les arrêts techniques et les arrêts pour assurer la préparation en vue d'un fonctionnement à haute disponibilité.
• En tant qu'expert en charge, commander et exploiter la source, la régler précisément pour optimiser les performances et la stabilité pour Linac3 et les injecteurs en aval, en assurant le respect des spécifications de qualité des faisceaux pour les parcours d'ions CERN et divers essais.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions techniques pour tester et valider la production de différentes espèces d'ions demandées pour les futurs programmes de physique.
• Faites partie de l'équipe d'experts de la machine, contribuant à des opérations de faisceaux plus larges et participant à la rotation du service d'appel pour assurer le fonctionnement fiable de l'injecteur 24/7.

Partecipa al Dipartimento di Fisica Sperimentale del CERN (EP) e contribuisce alla prossima generazione di strumentazione per l'esperimento ATLAS presso l'High-Luminosity LHC. Potrai lavorare in stretta collaborazione con team internazionali che contribuiscono al LUminosity Cherenkov Integrating Detector (LUCID-3) e l'High-Luminosity Zero Degree Calorimeter (HL-ZDC). Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per lavorare all'avanguardia della fisica delle particelle sperimentali, combinando hardware, firmware e sviluppo software in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e internazionale. Le tue responsabilità
• Contribuisci al test e alla validazione dei componenti per l'aggiornamento ATLAS Forward Detector.
• Sviluppo e manutenzione di software per l'acquisizione di dati elettronica.
• Progettazione e supporto di strumenti di monitoraggio online.
• Svolgere un ruolo attivo nelle attività di laboratorio presso il CERN, tra cui il test dei singoli componenti elettronici e la validazione della catena di lettura completa dei rivelatori all'interno dei laboratori Forward Detectors. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza comprovata con sistemi di acquisizione dati in esperimenti fisici ad alta energia, tra cui lettura e integrazione dei rivelatori.
• La familiarità con il firmware (ad esempio sistemi basati su FPGA) e l'integrazione hardware-software è altamente auspicabile.
• L'esperienza con i sistemi di monitoraggio online e la valutazione della qualità dei dati in tempo reale è un bene.
• La comprensione dei sistemi di attivazione (in particolare Level-1) e dei concetti di controllo/operazione dei rilevatori è vantaggiosa.
• Esperienza pratica nel lavoro di laboratorio, tra cui test e validazione di componenti elettronici e catene di lettura. Competenze
• Forte capacità di programmazione in C++ e Python, con solida esperienza in ambienti UNIX/Linux.
• Esperienza con la gestione, l'analisi e la visualizzazione dei dati basati su ROOT.
• Dimostrata capacità di problem solving e un atteggiamento proattivo, "can-do", con la volontà di contribuire al funzionamento del rivelatore e attività on-call.
• Approccio rigoroso e ben organizzato al lavoro, con attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di fornire risultati di alta qualità.
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente sia in modo indipendente che in un ambiente di team collaborativo internazionale.
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Criteri di ammissibilità:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a hands-on physicist with a strong interest in advanced detector technologies and software development? Join CERN's Experimental Physics (EP) Department and contribute to the next generation of instrumentation for the ATLAS experiment at the High-Luminosity LHC.
You will work in close collaboration with international teams contributing to the LUminosity Cherenkov Integrating Detector (LUCID-3) and the High-Luminosity Zero Degree Calorimeter (HL-ZDC).
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of experimental particle physics, combining hardware, firmware and software development in a highly collaborative and international environment.
Your responsibilities

• Contribute to the the testing and validation of components for the ATLAS Forward Detector upgrade.

• Development and maintenance of software for data acquisition electronics.

• Design and support of online monitoring tools.

• Play an active role in laboratory-based activities at CERN, including the testing of individual electronics components and the validation of the full detector readout chain within the Forward Detectors laboratories.
Your profile

• Proven experience with data acquisition systems in high-energy physics experiments, including detector readout and integration.

• Familiarity with firmware (e.g. FPGA-based systems) and hardware-software integration is highly desirable.

• Experience with online monitoring systems and real-time data quality assessment is an asset.

• Understanding of trigger systems (in particular Level-1) and detector control/operation concepts is advantageous.

• Practical experience in laboratory work, including testing and validation of electronics components and readout chains.
Skills

• Strong programming skills in C++ and Python, with solid experience in UNIX/Linux environments.

• Experience with ROOT-based data handling, analysis, and visualisation.

• Demonstrated problem-solving ability and a proactive, "can-do" attitude, with willingness to contribute to detector operation and on-call activities.

• Rigorous and well-organised approach to work, with attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality results.

• Ability to work effectively both independently and within an international, collaborative team environment.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics or related (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 16.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-ATL-AM-2026-119-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
You will join our multicultural team of around 20 Talent Acquisition colleagues to attract and hire diverse talent for CERN’s scientific and technical missions. Each team member partners with specific client groups, and brings their knowledge, ideas and diverse strengths to the team.

Together we have some ambitious goals, such as increasing the representation of women in STEM and strengthening nationality diversity in all types of hires, from students to seasoned professionals. You will be expected to handle big volumes of recruitment, and contribute to the shaping of first-class recruitment experiences for all stakeholders.
Functions

• Partner with hiring teams and stakeholder groups to deliver on their recruitment needs. This includes translating their needs in market-ready job ads and attraction strategies; facilitating fair, transparent and inclusive selection processes.

• Deliver a seamless, welcoming and inclusive candidate experience from first contact through to offer and onboarding.

• Build and engage relevant talent communities.

• Contribute to the overall employer branding strategies and its translation into practice with proposals, engaging with the public through social media and representing CERN at events.

• Support the shaping of our future recruitment processes in particular for students and grads by staying informed and curious, translating findings in a creative and/or open-minded collaboration.

• Use internal and external data as appropriate for decision making and reporting.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.

Experience
Experience in :

• End-to-end recruitment within an in-house team, ideally in an international environment.

• Sourcing and engaging talent across different roles; Employer Branding, Social Media and Outreach initiatives.

• HR data and analytics to drive and support informed decision-making is considered as an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Talent Acquisition: mastery of talent acquisition processes and best practices.

• Customer service: strong ability to provide excellent service to internal and external stakeholders.

• Direct sourcing: proficiency in proactive sourcing techniques and tools to proactively identify and engage potential candidates.

• Information content publishing: knowledge and use of applicant tracking systems and other web-based applications.
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Working in Teams: contributing to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addressing issues.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• Demonstrating Accountability: using openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 15.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Hybrid
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: HR-TA-2026-130-LD
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark Job Title: Human Resources Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join our Human Resources People eXperience and Engagement team of HR Coordinators and HR Advisors to play a key role in shaping the employee journey at CERN, supporting a diverse community of students, graduates, and staff while navigating a dynamic and evolving environment, by designing and delivering tailored HR support, services, and policies. If you have an eye for detail and a genuine interest in people and HR matters, are keen to gain a deep understanding of HR processes, and develop your interpersonal skills, then this is the right position for you.
Your responsibilities:

• Ensure efficient, friendly, and reliable administration and communication for various HR processes and queries, supporting HR professionals and their client departments.

• Inform and advise student and graduate populations throughout their experience at CERN on several topics (regulations, integration, processes, etc.).

• Deliver engaging presentations on HR topics to a variety of audiences, both within and beyond the group.

• Master the swift administration of contractual actions for several populations.
Your profile:

• Experience dealing with discretion and confidentiality.

• Interest/experience with delivering presentations.

• Interest/experience with customer service roles.
Skills:

• Effective written and oral communication, adapting the style to different audiences.

• Working in teams, promoting a positive atmosphere through an optimistic and constructive attitude.

• Maintaning discretion and accountability.

• Delivering high-quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Proactive attitude on taking on activities and tasks without prompting.

• MS Office knowledge.

• Presentation crafting and delivering skills.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Human Resources, Administration, related (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 19.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-September-2026
Job reference: HR-PXE-2026-174-GRAE
Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement)
Benchmark job: 5B0130 - Human Resources Support Officer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

Gli ambienti di tracciamento del senso in esperimenti presso l'High-Luminosity LHC del CERN e i futuri esperimenti FCC richiedono un maggiore utilizzo delle informazioni di temporizzazione oltre alle misurazioni di posizione fornite dai rilevatori di pixel. Questo aggiunge una dimensione aggiuntiva alle informazioni disponibili ed è essenziale per mitigare gli effetti di accumulazione ad alta luminosità. Il progetto CASSIA (CMOS Active SenSor with Internal Amplification) mira a sviluppare sensori di pixel attivi monolitici (MAPS) con guadagno di segnale interno e basso rumore in un processo di imaging CMOS ampiamente utilizzato, mirando a una vasta gamma di applicazioni. Le tue responsabilità
• Assemblare e testare i prototipi dei sensori CASSIA su PCB.
• Supporto e miglioramento delle misurazioni dei segnali nelle misurazioni di laboratorio, irradiazioni e travi di prova.
• Analizzare CASSIA2 per la raccolta ottimale del segnale e la risoluzione del tempo.
• Indagare la durezza delle radiazioni e il cambiamento del guadagno come funzione di irradiazione.
• Test CASSIA2 sui circuiti amplificatore chip contro la simulazione del circuito, caratterizzano le prestazioni del circuito front-end (FE) per la risoluzione del tempo e il rapporto segnale-rumore (SNR).
• Migliorare la progettazione dei circuiti CASSIA2 per una risoluzione ottimale del tempo in modalità LGAD e SPAD.
• Sviluppare concetti per l'integrazione di modelli di pixel CASSIA in circuiti pixel di lettura asincrono in matrici (studi CASSIA3).
• Progettazione e implementazione del circuito, verifica della progettazione, simulazioni pre-/post-layout per design pixel ottimizzati e circuiti FE per grandi matrici.
• Collabora a stretto contatto con ingegneri, fisici e tecnici in un team multidisciplinare. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza con l'assemblaggio, il collaudo e la caratterizzazione di moduli rivelatori di silicio o sistemi simili.
• Esperienza pratica con strumentazione di laboratorio come stazioni di sonda, configurazioni di test laser, configurazioni di test del raggio.
• Capacità di progettare PCB per ASIC/sensori come parte del sistema di test.
• Capacità di eseguire misurazioni elettroniche per caratterizzare circuiti analogici e digitali su chip.
• Esperienza nell'automazione di procedure di laboratorio e acquisizione dati.
• Esperienza con strumenti utilizzati per la progettazione, l'integrazione e la verifica dei sensori ASIC/CMOS.
• Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati, la simulazione dei circuiti e il debug elettronico.
• Esperienza di lavoro in grandi collaborazioni di ricerca internazionali e contribuire a infrastrutture comuni o strutture condivise.
• Dimostrata capacità di pianificare, prioritizzare e fornire risultati in tempi stretti. Competenze
• Conoscenza dei sensori CMOS monolitici, MAPS, rilevatori di pixel in silicio per esperimenti fisici ad alta energia.
• Esperienza nella sperimentazione di sensori di silicio e attrezzature di laboratorio necessarie.
• Esperienza nella simulazione e caratterizzazione dei circuiti.
• Esperienza di lavoro nella progettazione di sensori ASIC e/o CMOS e utilizzando strumenti di settore per la progettazione, l'implementazione e la verifica.
• Approccio organizzato, preciso e indipendente al lavoro.
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team multidisciplinari e collaborazioni internazionali.
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Criteri di ammissibilità:
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .
• Hai uno sfondo professionale in Elettronica o Fisica (o un campo correlato) e hanno o:
• un Master con 2 a 6 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione;
• o un dottorato con non più di 3 anni di esperienza professionale post-graduazione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Dense tracking environments in experiments at CERN's High-Luminosity LHC and future FCC experiments require increased use of timing information in addition to the position measurements provided by pixel detectors. This adds an extra dimension to the available information and is essential for mitigating pile-up effects at high luminosities. The CASSIA Project (CMOS Active SenSor with Internal Amplification) aims to develop monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) with internal signal gain and low noise in a widely used CMOS imaging process, targeting a broad range of applications.
Your responsibilities

• Assemble and test CASSIA sensor prototypes on PCBs.

• Support and improve signal measurements in laboratory measurements, irradiations and test beams.

• Analyse CASSIA2 for optimal signal collection and time resolution.

• Investigate radiation hardness and the change of gain as a function of irradiation.

Les environnements de suivi denses dans les expériences du CERN à haute luminosité LHC et les expériences futures du FCC nécessitent une utilisation accrue de l'information sur le moment en plus des mesures de position fournies par les détecteurs de pixels. Cela ajoute une dimension supplémentaire à l'information disponible et est essentiel pour atténuer les effets d'empilement à haute luminosité. Le projet CASSIA (CMOS Active Sensor with Internal Amplification) vise à développer des capteurs de pixel actifs monolithiques (MAPS) avec gain de signal interne et faible bruit dans un processus d'imagerie CMOS largement utilisé, ciblant un large éventail d'applications. Vos responsabilités
• Assembler et tester des prototypes de capteurs CASSIA sur des PCB.
• Soutenir et améliorer les mesures des signaux dans les mesures en laboratoire, les irradiations et les faisceaux d'essai.
• Analyser CASSIA2 pour une collecte optimale des signaux et une résolution du temps.
• Étudier la dureté du rayonnement et le changement de gain en fonction de l'irradiation.
• Tester CASSIA2 sur les circuits amplificateurs de puces contre la simulation du circuit, caractériser les performances du circuit frontal (FE) pour la résolution du temps et le rapport signal-bruit (SNR).
• Améliorer la conception des circuits CASSIA2 pour une résolution de temps optimale en mode LGAD et SPAD.
• Élaborer des concepts pour l'intégration des conceptions de pixel CASSIA dans les circuits de lecture asynchrone de pixel dans les matrices (études CASSIA3).
• Conception et mise en œuvre de circuits, vérification de conception, simulations pré-/post-layout pour des conceptions de pixel optimisées et circuits FE pour grandes matrices.

• Expérience de l'assemblage, des essais et de la caractérisation de modules détecteurs de silicium ou de systèmes similaires.

• Capacité de concevoir des PCB pour les AEC/capteurs dans le cadre du système d'essai.
• Capacité d'effectuer des mesures électroniques pour caractériser les circuits analogiques et numériques sur puce.
• Expérience dans l'automatisation des procédures de laboratoire et l'acquisition de données.
• Expérience des outils utilisés pour la conception, l'intégration et la vérification des capteurs ASIC/CMOS.
• Connaissance de l'analyse des données, de la simulation des circuits et du débogage électronique.

• Capacité démontrée de planifier, de hiérarchiser et de produire des résultats selon des calendriers serrés. Compétences

En tant qu'ingénieur de projet au sein du département SCE (Projet Portfolio Management Group), vous contribuerez à la réalisation de projets de construction complexes au CERN. Sous la direction d'un gestionnaire de projet du CERN, vous coordonnerez les interfaces avec les intervenants internes et externes tout au long des phases de conception et de construction, assurant une collaboration harmonieuse tout en respectant les objectifs techniques, de planification, budgétaires et de sécurité. Vos responsabilités :
• Participer à des études de faisabilité et à la conception préliminaire de nouveaux projets, y compris la coordination des services de conception du génie civil avec les bureaux de conception externes (architectes/ingénieurs) et d'autres équipements/services (services de construction MEP et équipement d'accélérateur), ce qui a conduit à la soumission de conceptions détaillées aux utilisateurs du CERN.
• Participer à la préparation des appels d'offres, à la sélection des entreprises, à l'ouverture des offres et aux décisions relatives à la sélection des concepteurs ou entrepreneurs.

• Organiser des procédures de transfert des travaux civils, suivre tout travail ultérieur nécessaire pour assurer le respect des spécifications et veiller à ce que toutes les mesures de sécurité soient mises en œuvre sur place pour réduire au minimum le taux d'accident. Votre profil:
• Intérêt pour les projets de construction et la coordination des projets, avec une volonté d'apprendre sous la direction d'ingénieurs chevronnés.
• Organisé, proactif, flexible et capable de travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement multitâches.
• Bonne communication et esprit d'équipe dans un environnement international, avec une approche ouverte et diplomatique. Compétences :
• Bonne connaissance des outils de gestion de projet, y compris la compétence dans la suite MS Office et le projet MS.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation.
• Anglais ou français parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre l'autre langue. Critères d'éligibilité:

• Travail dans les zones de rayonnement.

Introduzione In qualità di tecnico elettromeccanico versatile con esperienza nell'installazione e nel mantenimento di un'ampia gamma di attrezzature, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'aggiornamento delle infrastrutture e nell'implementazione del progetto di aggiornamento ATLAS (2026–2030). Nell'ambito del team di coordinamento tecnico ATLAS, vi legherete con i team di rivelatori, contribuite alla decommissione delle apparecchiature esistenti e parteciperete all'installazione e alla messa in servizio della nuova infrastruttura rack, supportando i team di rivelatori nel loro lavoro di installazione. Funzioni
• Partecipare alla decommissione di rack elettronici esistenti.
• Contribuisci all'installazione di nuovi rack nelle caverne dei servizi sotterranei, compresi i sistemi di raffreddamento e distribuzione del rack e le turbine di ventilazione, per soddisfare le future esigenze dei sistemi di rivelatore ATLAS.
• Partecipare alla messa in servizio dei rack ed essere responsabile della manutenzione dei sistemi di raffreddamento e distribuzione di energia rack, compresa la gestione dei pezzi di ricambio.
• Contribuire al montaggio, installazione e manutenzione di turbine di ventilazione rack.
• Supporta l'aggiornamento e la manutenzione dell'hardware Detector Safety System (DSS).
• Partecipa al routing dei cavi e all'installazione di apparecchiature elettromeccaniche per l'infrastruttura dei rivelatori ATLAS.
• Supporta la manutenzione di dispositivi di controllo e monitoraggio ambientali comuni (ad esempio, webcam, temperatura e sensori di umidità, ecc.).
• Sostenere il funzionamento, la manutenzione e la ristrutturazione delle strutture di superficie ATLAS.
• Coordinate, in collaborazione con il gruppo responsabile di Access & Alarms, la manutenzione del sistema sniffer utilizzato per monitorare la concentrazione di fumo o gas infiammabile.
• Fai parte del team di chiamata Detector Safety System (DSS). Diploma tecnico superiore o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'elettromeccanica o di un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Esperienza dimostrata nella manutenzione e nel montaggio di sistemi elettromeccanici.
• È necessaria una conoscenza approfondita della distribuzione elettrica, del cablaggio, dei sensori e del raffreddamento ad acqua.
• La conoscenza dei sistemi di ventilazione e sniffer è un vantaggio.
• Competenza nel lavoro su vari progetti in parallelo.
• L'esperienza nella pianificazione e nel coordinamento dei lavori di manutenzione è un vantaggio. Competenze tecniche:
• Costruzione, prova e installazione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettromeccanici.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettromeccanici.
• Funzionamento e manutenzione di circuiti elettrici e reti.
• Test elettromeccanici. Competenze comportamentali:
• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: accettare prontamente nuovi compiti o progetti.
• Ottenere risultati: fornire lavoro di alta qualità nel tempo e soddisfare le aspettative.
• Gestire il Sé: lavorare bene autonomamente; svolgere attività e compiti senza sollecitare. Capacità linguistiche: Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 14.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST . Condizioni di lavoro Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco Questa posizione comporta:

• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
As a versatile electromechanical technician with experience in installing and maintaining a wide range of equipment, you will play a key role in the infrastructure upgrade and implementation of the ATLAS upgrade project (2026–2030). As part of the ATLAS Technical Coordination team, you will liaise with detector teams, contribute to the decommissioning of existing equipment, and participate in the installation and commissioning of the new rack infrastructure, while supporting detector teams in their installation work.

Functions

• Participate in the decommissioning of existing electronics racks.

• Contribute to the installation of new racks in the underground service caverns, including rack cooling and power distribution systems as well as ventilation turbines, to meet the future needs of the ATLAS detector systems.

• Participate in the commissioning of the racks and be responsible for the maintenance of rack cooling and  power distribution systems, including spare parts management.

• Contribute to the assembly, installation, and maintenance of rack ventilation turbines.

• Support the upgrade and maintenance of the PLC-based Detector Safety System (DSS) hardware.

• Participate in cable routing and in the installation of electromechanical equipment for ATLAS detector infrastructure.

• Support the maintenance of common environmental control and monitoring devices (e.g., webcams, temperature, and humidity sensors, etc.).

• Support the operation, maintenance and refurbishment of the ATLAS surface facilities.

• Coordinate, in collaboration with the group responsible for Access & Alarms, the maintenance of the sniffer system used to monitor the concentration of smoke or flammable gas.

• Be part of the Detector Safety System (DSS) on-call team.

Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electromechanics or a related field.

Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in the maintenance and assembly of electromechanical systems.

• Proven knowledge of electrical distribution, cabling, sensors and water cooling is required.

• Knowledge of ventilation and sniffer systems is an advantage.

• Proficiency in working on various projects in parallel.

• Experience in scheduling and coordinating maintenance work is an advantage.
Technical competencies:

• Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.

• Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.

• Electromechanical testing.
Behavioural competencies:

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily accepting new tasks or work/projects.

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting.
Language skills:
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST .
Employment Conditions
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 3-4
Job reference: EP-ATL-SO-2026-129-LD
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Electromechanical Technician

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

• Kenntnisse in der Arbeit an verschiedenen Projekten parallel.
• Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination von Wartungsarbeiten ist von Vorteil. Technische Kompetenzen:
• Bau, Prüfung und Installation von elektromechanischen Geräten und Systemen.
• Betrieb und Wartung von elektromechanischen Geräten und Systemen.
• Betrieb und Wartung von Stromkreisen und Netzen.
• Elektromechanische Prüfung. Verhaltenskompetenzen:
• Arbeiten in Teams: Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver und effektiver Arbeitsbeziehungen.

Présentation En tant que technicien électromécanique polyvalent ayant l'expérience de l'installation et de l'entretien d'un large éventail d'équipements, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise à niveau et la mise en œuvre de l'infrastructure du projet de mise à niveau ATLAS (2026-2030). Dans le cadre de l'équipe de coordination technique ATLAS, vous assurerez la liaison avec les équipes de détecteurs, contribuerez au démantèlement des équipements existants et participerez à l'installation et à la mise en service de la nouvelle infrastructure de rack, tout en soutenant les équipes de détecteurs dans leurs travaux d'installation. Fonctions
• Participer au déclassement des racks électroniques existants.
• Contribuer à l'installation de nouveaux racks dans les cavernes souterraines de service, y compris les systèmes de refroidissement et de distribution d'électricité ainsi que les turbines de ventilation, pour répondre aux besoins futurs des systèmes de détecteurs ATLAS.
• Participer à la mise en service des racks et être responsable de l'entretien des systèmes de refroidissement et de distribution d'électricité, y compris la gestion des pièces de rechange.
• Contribuer à l'assemblage, à l'installation et à l'entretien des turbines de ventilation à rack.
• Soutenir la mise à niveau et la maintenance du matériel du système de sécurité des détecteurs (DSS) basé sur PLC.
• Participer à l'acheminement des câbles et à l'installation d'équipements électromécaniques pour l'infrastructure des détecteurs ATLAS.
• Soutenir la maintenance de dispositifs communs de contrôle et de surveillance de l'environnement (par exemple, webcams, capteurs de température et d'humidité, etc.).
• Soutenir l'exploitation, l'entretien et la rénovation des installations de surface ATLAS.
• Coordonner, en collaboration avec le groupe responsable de l'accès et des alarmes, l'entretien du système de sniffer utilisé pour surveiller la concentration de fumée ou de gaz inflammable.
• Faites partie de l'équipe sur appel du système de sécurité des détecteurs (DSS). Diplôme technique supérieur ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine de l'électromécanique ou dans un domaine connexe. Expérience :
• Expérience démontrée dans l'entretien et l'assemblage des systèmes électromécaniques.
• Une connaissance éprouvée de la distribution électrique, du câblage, des capteurs et du refroidissement de l'eau est nécessaire.
• La connaissance des systèmes de ventilation et de sniffer est un avantage.
• Compétence pour travailler sur divers projets en parallèle.
• L'expérience en matière de planification et de coordination des travaux de maintenance est un avantage. Compétences techniques:
• Construction, essai et installation d'équipements et de systèmes électromécaniques.
• Fonctionnement et entretien des équipements et systèmes électromécaniques.
• Fonctionnement et entretien des circuits et réseaux électriques.
• Essai électromécanique. Compétences comportementales :
• Travailler en équipe : établir et maintenir des relations de travail constructives et efficaces.
• Démontrer la souplesse : accepter facilement de nouvelles tâches ou travaux/projets.
• Atteindre des résultats : fournir un travail de haute qualité dans les délais et répondre aux attentes.
