Introduzione: Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria (EN) spinge avanti i limiti della tecnologia in modo che i fisici possono svolgere la loro ricerca. All'interno del reparto EN, il gruppo Mechanical and Materials Engineering (MME) fornisce alla comunità CERN soluzioni ingegneristiche specifiche che combinano design meccanico, fabbricazione e scienze materiali. Sei appassionato di meccanica, e sei abile nel design computer-aided? E' un'opportunita' per te. Sarete parte di un team di progetto multidisciplinare che progetta, realizza e testa una nuova generazione di componenti per il Future Circular Collider (FCC). In qualità di ingegnere tecnico meccanico presso l'ufficio di progettazione MME (EN-MME-MD), sarai responsabile dell'ingegneria meccanica e della progettazione di nuove attrezzature complesse e sistemi meccanici per progetti di fisica ad alta energia e nuovi acceleratori e in particolare per le apparecchiature Superconducting Radio Frequency (SRF) per la FCC. Studi strutturali e termomeccanici, progettazione di attrezzature a pressione, criogenia, tecnologia a vuoto ultra-alto, progettazione sostenibile e produzione, sicurezza, affidabilità, gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto sono solo alcune delle parole chiave relative a questa posizione. Funzioni:
• Gestione tecnica delle attività di ufficio di progettazione in collaborazione con altri servizi all'interno del gruppo EN-MME e con esperti e stakeholder CERN ampia, in particolare per l'accelerazione delle cavità nell'ambito del progetto FCC.
• Analisi dei requisiti di progettazione basati su specifiche funzionali o altre informazioni rilevanti.
• Esecuzione di studi di progettazione di assemblaggi meccanici, componenti, utensili, integrazione attrezzature e layout.
• Creazione di modelli 3D dettagliati e disegni tecnici (comprese le specifiche, i dettagli, la fabbricazione, l'assemblaggio, l'installazione, i disegni as-costruiti e di verifica), in consultazione con gli esperti di produzione e materiali del CERN e nel rispetto dei relativi standard di progettazione e redazione.
• Preparazione della documentazione del progetto secondo le procedure di garanzia della qualità del Design Office.
• Preparazione di presentazioni, relazioni tecniche, specifiche tecniche e note di calcolo.
• Preparazione delle specifiche tecniche e partecipazione ai negoziati contrattuali.
• Seguito, in stretta interazione con altri team e servizi, della produzione, montaggio e installazione di componenti meccanici.
• Fornire la supervisione tecnica e la guida a un team di designer e disegnatori per garantire qualità, coerenza e conformità ai requisiti.
• Assicurare il follow-up di attività assegnate utilizzando strumenti amministrativi interni, tra cui la preparazione di stime, il mantenimento di descrizioni dei posti di lavoro, e il trattamento di modifiche per sostenere la fatturazione tempestiva e accurata.
• Corso di laurea o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Provata esperienza come designer in un ufficio di progettazione meccanica, eseguendo dimensionamento meccanico e utilizzando strumenti di analisi meccanica standard (analitica e numerica).
• Esperienza comprovata con design orientato al computer.
• Esperienza nella produzione di disegni tecnici di componenti e sistemi meccanici, idealmente secondo gli standard ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS) per il disegno di dimensionamento e tolerancing.
• L'esperienza con la suite software CATIA computer-aided-design sarebbe un bene. Competenze tecniche:
• Progettazione e costruzione di macchine: capacità di analizzare e risolvere problemi di ingegneria meccanica utilizzando la forza dei principi di selezione di materiali e materiali.
• Progettazione e analisi delle strutture meccaniche: con la conoscenza di base dei metodi di calcolo numerico e analitico.
• Produzione di disegni 2D e modelli 3D: nel rispetto degli standard rilevanti per il dimensionamento e il tolerancing del disegno, in particolare le specifiche del prodotto geometrico ISO (GPS).
• Assemblaggio di strutture e attrezzature meccaniche: conoscenza dei metodi di produzione e processi come la lavorazione, la formazione, l'adesione (ad esempio saldatura, brasatura).
• Configurazione e utilizzo di sistemi di gestione dell'informazione: capacità di utilizzare efficacemente gli strumenti Computer Aided Design (CAD) e Product Lifecycle Management (PLM). Competenze comportamentali:
• Building Relationships: mostrare un sincero interesse per le preoccupazioni e le prospettive degli altri.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: dimostrare la volontà di accettare circostanze mutevoli che sostengono iniziative di cambiamento.
• Gestire il Sé: prendere iniziativa oltre i compiti regolari e fare accadere le cose.
• Risolvere i problemi: identificare, definire e valutare i problemi, agire per affrontarli.
• Lavorare in team: sostenere e agire in conformità con le decisioni del team; accettare la responsabilità congiunta per i successi e le carenze del team. Capacità linguistiche:
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 14.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST. Scopri di più qui . Condizioni di lavoro: Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: completamente in loco Questa posizione comporta:
• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Lavoro a turni, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Lavoro a turni.
• In considerazione dei rischi per la salute sul lavoro associati a questa posizione, il candidato selezionato deve ottenere l'autorizzazione medica prima che venga confermata un'offerta contrattuale. Grado di lavoro: 4-5 Riferimento del lavoro: EN-MME-MD-2026-132-LD Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria meccanica Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Ingegnere tecnico meccanico Vantaggi globali
• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
The Engineering Department (EN) pushes forward the limits of technology so that physicists can carry out their research. Within the EN department, the Mechanical and Materials Engineering (MME) Group provides the CERN community with specific engineering solutions combining mechanical design, fabrication, and material sciences.
Are you passionate by mechanics, and are you skilled in computer-aided design? This is an opportunity for you. You will be part of a multidisciplinary project team designing, fabricating and testing a new generation of components for the Future Circular Collider (FCC).
As a Mechanical Technical Engineer in the MME Design Office (EN-MME-MD), you will be in charge of mechanical engineering and design of new complex equipment and mechanical systems for high-energy physics projects and new accelerators and in particular for Superconducting Radio Frequency (SRF) equipment for the FCC.

Structural and thermomechanical studies, design of pressure equipment, cryogenics, ultra-high vacuum technology, sustainable design and manufacturing, safety, reliability, product lifecycle management are just a few of the keywords related to this position.
Functions:

• Technical management of design office activities in collaboration with other services within the EN-MME group and with experts and stakeholders CERN wide, in particular for accelerating cavities within the scope of the FCC project.

• Analysis of design requirements based on functional specifications or other relevant information.

• Execution of design studies of mechanical assemblies, components, tooling, equipment integration and layout.

• Creation of detailed 3D models and technical drawings (including specification, detail, manufacturing, assembly, installation, as-built and verification drawings), in consultation with CERN manufacturing and materials experts and in compliance with relevant design and drafting standards.

• Preparation of the project documentation according to the Design Office quality assurance procedures.

• Preparation of presentations, technical reports, engineering specifications and calculation notes.

• Preparation of technical specification and participation in contract negotiations.

• Follow-up, in close interaction with other teams and services, of the manufacturing, assembling and installation of mechanical components.

• Provide technical oversight and guidance to a team of designers and draftsmen to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with requirements.

• Ensure follow-up of assigned activities using internal administrative tools, including the preparation of estimates, maintenance of job descriptions, and processing of amendments to support timely and accurate invoicing.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Proven experience as a designer in a mechanical design office, performing mechanical dimensioning and using standard mechanical analysis tools (both analytical and numerical).

• Proven experience with computer-aided design.

• Experience in the production of technical drawings of mechanical components and systems, ideally according to ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS) standards for drawing dimensioning and tolerancing.

• Experience with the CATIA computer-aided-design software suite would be an asset.
Technical competencies:

• Design and construction of machines: ability to analyse and solve mechanical engineering problems using strength of materials and materials selection principles.

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures: with basic knowledge of numerical and analytical calculation methods.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: in compliance with relevant standards for drawing dimensioning and tolerancing, in particular ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS).

• Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: knowledge of manufacturing methods and processes such as machining, forming, joining (e.g. welding, brazing).

• Configuration and use of information management systems: ability to effectively use Computer Aided Design (CAD) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools.
Behavioural competencies:

• Building Relationships: showing a sincere interest in the concerns and perspectives of others.

• Demonstrating Flexibility: demonstrating a willingness to accept changing circumstances supporting initiatives for change.

• Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.

• Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.

• Working in Teams: supporting and acting in accordance with team decisions; accepting joint responsibility for team successes and shortcomings.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Find out more here .
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• A valid driving licence.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.

• Shift work.

• Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job grade: 4-5
Job reference: EN-MME-MD-2026-132-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für Mechanik und sind Sie in computergestütztem Design erfahren? Dies ist eine Chance für Sie. Sie werden Teil eines multidisziplinären Projektteams sein, das eine neue Generation von Komponenten für den Future Circular Collider (FCC) entwickelt, herstellt und testet. Als Mechanical Technical Engineer im MME Design Office (EN-MME-MD) sind Sie für den Maschinenbau und das Design neuer komplexer Geräte und mechanischer Systeme für hochenergetische Physikprojekte und neue Beschleuniger und insbesondere für supraleitende Funkfrequenzgeräte (SRF) für die FCC verantwortlich. Strukturelle und thermomechanische Studien, Design von Druckgeräten, Kryotechnik, Ultrahochvakuumtechnologie, nachhaltiges Design und Herstellung, Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit, Produktlebenszyklusmanagement sind nur einige der Schlüsselwörter, die mit dieser Position verbunden sind. Funktionen:
• Technisches Management von Design-Office-Aktivitäten in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Diensten innerhalb der EN-MME-Gruppe und mit Experten und Stakeholdern im gesamten CERN, insbesondere zur Beschleunigung von Hohlräumen im Rahmen des FCC-Projekts.
• Analyse der Konstruktionsanforderungen auf der Grundlage funktionaler Spezifikationen oder anderer relevanter Informationen.
• Durchführung von Konstruktionsstudien zu mechanischen Baugruppen, Bauteilen, Werkzeugen, Ausrüstungsintegration und Layout.
• Erstellung detaillierter 3D-Modelle und technischer Zeichnungen (einschließlich Spezifikation, Details, Herstellung, Montage, Installation, As-Built und Verifizierungszeichnungen), in Absprache mit CERN-Fertigungs- und Materialexperten und in Übereinstimmung mit den relevanten Design- und Entwurfsstandards.
• Erstellung der Projektdokumentation nach den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren des Design Office.
• Erstellung von Präsentationen, technischen Berichten, technischen Spezifikationen und Berechnungshinweisen.
• Erstellung technischer Spezifikationen und Teilnahme an Vertragsverhandlungen.
• Follow-up, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams und Dienstleistungen, der Herstellung, Montage und Montage von mechanischen Komponenten.
• Bereitstellung technischer Aufsicht und Anleitung für ein Team von Designern und Zeichnern, um Qualität, Konsistenz und Einhaltung der Anforderungen sicherzustellen.
• Gewährleistung der Weiterverfolgung der zugewiesenen Tätigkeiten unter Verwendung interner Verwaltungsinstrumente, einschließlich der Erstellung von Schätzungen, der Pflege von Stellenbeschreibungen und der Bearbeitung von Änderungen, um eine rechtzeitige und genaue Rechnungsstellung zu unterstützen.
• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten Bereich. Erfahrung:
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Konstrukteur in einem Büro für mechanische Konstruktion, Durchführung mechanischer Dimensionierung und Verwendung von mechanischen Standardanalysewerkzeugen (analytisch und numerisch).
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit computergestütztem Design.
• Erfahrung in der Herstellung von technischen Zeichnungen von mechanischen Komponenten und Systemen, idealerweise nach ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS) Standards für Zeichnungsdimensionierung und Tolerierung.
• Erfahrung mit der CATIA Computer-Aided-Design-Software-Suite wäre ein Gewinn. Technische Kompetenzen:
• Entwurf und Bau von Maschinen: Fähigkeit, Maschinenbauprobleme unter Verwendung der Festigkeit von Materialien und Materialauswahlprinzipien zu analysieren und zu lösen.
• Design und Analyse von mechanischen Strukturen: mit Grundkenntnissen der numerischen und analytischen Berechnungsmethoden.
• Herstellung von 2D-Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen: in Übereinstimmung mit den einschlägigen Normen für die Dimensionierung und Tolerierung von Zeichnungen, insbesondere ISO Geometrical Product Specifications (GPS).
• Montage von mechanischen Strukturen und Ausrüstung: Kenntnis der Herstellungsmethoden und -prozesse wie Bearbeitung, Umformen, Fügen (z. B. Schweißen, Löten).
• Konfiguration und Nutzung von Informationsmanagementsystemen: Fähigkeit, CAD- und PLM-Tools (Computer Aided Design) effektiv zu nutzen. Verhaltenskompetenzen:
• Aufbau von Beziehungen: ein aufrichtiges Interesse an den Anliegen und Perspektiven anderer zeigen.
• Flexibilität demonstrieren: Bereitschaft zeigen, sich ändernde Umstände zu akzeptieren, die Initiativen für Veränderungen unterstützen.
• Selbstmanagement: Initiative ergreifen, die über normale Aufgaben hinausgeht und Dinge möglich macht.
• Probleme lösen: Probleme identifizieren, definieren und bewerten, Maßnahmen ergreifen, um sie zu lösen.
• Arbeiten in Teams: Unterstützung und Handeln in Übereinstimmung mit Teamentscheidungen; Mitverantwortung für Teamerfolge und -mängel übernehmen. Sprachkenntnisse:

Introduction: Le département d'ingénierie (EN) fait avancer les limites de la technologie afin que les physiciens puissent effectuer leurs recherches. Au sein du département EN, le Groupe d'Ingénierie Mécanique et Matériaux (MME) fournit à la communauté CERN des solutions techniques spécifiques combinant conception mécanique, fabrication et sciences des matériaux. Êtes-vous passionné par la mécanique, et êtes-vous qualifié en conception assistée par ordinateur? C'est une opportunité pour vous. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe de projet multidisciplinaire qui conçoit, fabrique et teste une nouvelle génération de composants pour le futur collisionneur circulaire (FCC). En tant qu'ingénieur technique au MME Design Office (EN-MME-MD), vous serez en charge de l'ingénierie mécanique et de la conception de nouveaux équipements et systèmes mécaniques complexes pour des projets de physique à haute énergie et de nouveaux accélérateurs, et en particulier pour les équipements de radiofréquence supraconductrice (SRF) pour la FCC. Etudes structurales et thermomécaniques, conception d'équipement sous pression, cryogénique, technologie ultra-haute dépression, conception et fabrication durables, sécurité, fiabilité, gestion du cycle de vie des produits ne sont que quelques-uns des mots clés liés à cette position. Fonctions:
• Gestion technique des activités des bureaux de design en collaboration avec d'autres services du groupe EN-MME et avec des experts et des parties prenantes à l'échelle du CERN, en particulier pour accélérer les cavités dans le cadre du projet FCC.
• Analyse des exigences de conception sur la base de spécifications fonctionnelles ou d'autres informations pertinentes.
• Réalisation d'études de conception d'assemblages mécaniques, de composants, d'outillage, d'intégration et de mise en page des équipements.
• Création de modèles 3D détaillés et de dessins techniques (y compris les spécifications, les détails, la fabrication, l'assemblage, l'installation, les dessins de construction et de vérification), en consultation avec les experts en fabrication et matériaux du CERN et conformément aux normes de conception et de rédaction pertinentes.
• Préparation de la documentation du projet conformément aux procédures d'assurance de la qualité du bureau de conception.
• Préparation de présentations, de rapports techniques, de spécifications techniques et de notes de calcul.
• Préparation des spécifications techniques et participation aux négociations contractuelles.
• Suivi, en interaction étroite avec d'autres équipes et services, de la fabrication, de l'assemblage et de l'installation de composants mécaniques.
• Fournir une supervision technique et des conseils à une équipe de concepteurs et de dessinateurs pour assurer la qualité, l'uniformité et le respect des exigences.
• Assurer le suivi des activités assignées à l'aide d'outils administratifs internes, y compris l'établissement des estimations, la tenue à jour des descriptions de travail et le traitement des modifications à l'appui de la facturation exacte et en temps opportun.
• Baccalauréat ou expérience équivalente pertinente dans le domaine du génie mécanique ou un domaine connexe. Expérience :
• Expérience éprouvée en tant que concepteur dans un bureau de conception mécanique, en effectuant des dimensions mécaniques et en utilisant des outils d'analyse mécanique standard (à la fois analytique et numérique).
• Expérience éprouvée avec la conception assistée par ordinateur.
• Expérience dans la production de dessins techniques de composants et systèmes mécaniques, idéalement selon les normes ISO Geometical Product Specifications (GPS) pour le dimensionnement et la tolérance.
• L'expérience de la suite logicielle de conception assistée par ordinateur de CATIA serait un atout. Compétences techniques:
• Conception et construction de machines : capacité d'analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d'ingénierie mécanique en utilisant la résistance des matériaux et les principes de sélection des matériaux.
• Conception et analyse des structures mécaniques: connaissance de base des méthodes de calcul numériques et analytiques.
• Production de dessins 2D et de modèles 3D: en conformité avec les normes pertinentes de dimensionnement et de tolérance, en particulier les spécifications de produit géométrique (GPS) ISO.
• Assemblage de structures et d'équipements mécaniques: connaissance des méthodes et procédés de fabrication tels que l'usinage, le formage, l'assemblage (par exemple le soudage, le brasage).
• Configuration et utilisation des systèmes de gestion de l'information : capacité d'utiliser efficacement les outils de conception assistée par ordinateur (CAD) et de gestion du cycle de vie des produits (GPL). Compétences comportementales :
• Construire des relations: montrer un intérêt sincère pour les préoccupations et les perspectives des autres.
• Démontrer la souplesse : démontrer la volonté d'accepter l'évolution des circonstances à l'appui des initiatives de changement.
• Gérer soi: prendre des initiatives au-delà des tâches régulières et faire les choses arriver.
• Résoudre les problèmes : identifier, définir et évaluer les problèmes, prendre des mesures pour y remédier.
• Travailler en équipe : appuyer et agir conformément aux décisions de l'équipe; accepter la responsabilité conjointe des succès et des lacunes de l'équipe. Compétences linguistiques :
• Anglais parlé et écrit, avec un engagement à apprendre le français. Ce poste sera pourvu dès que possible et les candidatures devraient normalement nous parvenir au plus tard le 14.07.2026 à 23h59 CEST. En savoir plus ici . Sous réserve de certaines conditions, les titulaires de contrats à durée limitée peuvent demander un emploi pour une durée indéterminée. Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu. Si vous êtes prêt à faire partie d'une communauté dynamique et inclusive qui repousse les limites du savoir, le CERN est l'endroit où votre curiosité et vos compétences peuvent prospérer. Il CERN Document Server (CDS ) è il repository istituzionale del CERN, dedicato all'archiviazione, alla conservazione e alla diffusione di risultati di ricerca, contenuti multimediali e altri documenti chiave prodotti dall'organizzazione. Stiamo costruendo la piattaforma web di nuova generazione basata sulla tecnologia open source InvenioRDM, e come laureato, si svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nella modellazione del suo futuro. Il nostro obiettivo ultimo è quello di creare un flusso di lavoro senza soluzione di continuità per i ricercatori, consentendo loro di archiviare, pubblicare e condividere le uscite di ricerca, tra cui software, dati e documenti, in modo più semplice ed efficiente. Questa è un'opportunità unica per dare un impatto significativo su come i ricercatori del CERN gestiscono e divulgano il loro lavoro. Le tue responsabilità
• Sviluppare e mantenere applicazioni web utilizzando Python sul backend e React sul frontend e implementare nuove funzionalità per supportare l'archiviazione, la pubblicazione e la condivisione delle uscite di ricerca.
• Contribuisci alla migrazione dei contenuti esistenti a una nuova piattaforma digitale, garantendo qualità e coerenza dei dati.
• Scrivere, testare e rivedere il codice per garantire affidabilità, prestazioni e manutenbilità.
• Collabora con gli ingegneri del software e gli utenti finali per comprendere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche.
• Documentare soluzioni tecniche e contribuire alla documentazione degli utenti e degli sviluppatori.
• Imparare e applicare le migliori pratiche in ingegneria del software, controllo della versione e lavoro di squadra agile. Il tuo profilo
• Esperienza con Python e sviluppo delle applicazioni web (ad esempio utilizzando Flask o framework simili).
• Conoscenza di base di JavaScript e moderne interfacce web (ad esempio React o librerie simili).
• Familiarità con sistemi di controllo delle versioni, come Git.
• Capacità di scrivere codice chiaro e mantenibile e imparare nuove tecnologie.
• Esperienza con database relazionali, come PostgreSQL.
• Familiarità con le tecnologie di ricerca o indicizzazione, come Elasticsearch o OpenSearch.
• Esposizione a tecnologie container, come Docker e piattaforme container (ad esempio OpenShift).
• Esperienza contribuendo o lavorando con progetti software open source. Competenze
• Python, Flask, JavaScript, React, Git sono necessarie competenze.
• Le competenze PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch sono vantaggiose.
• Docker, le abilità di OpenShift sono vantaggiose.
• L'esperienza di lavoro su progetti open source è vantaggiosa.
• Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Criteri di ammissibilità:
• Sei un cittadino di uno Stato membro del CERN o di uno Stato membro associato .
• Con la scadenza dell'applicazione, si dispone di un massimo di due anni di esperienza professionale dalla laurea in Ingegneria del software (o un campo correlato) e la vostra più alta qualifica educativa è sia una laurea o master.
• Non hai mai avuto un contratto di laurea o di socio del CERN.
• I candidati senza laurea non sono ammissibili.

• Una spesa mensile tra 5266-5793 Franco Svizzero al mese (gratuito dalla tassa) a seconda della laurea.

Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
The CERN Document Server ( CDS ) is CERN's institutional repository, dedicated to archiving, preserving, and disseminating research outputs, multimedia content, and other key documents produced by the organisation. We are building the next-generation web platform based on the open-source technology InvenioRDM, and as a Graduate, you will play a crucial role in shaping its future.
Our ultimate goal is to create a seamless workflow for researchers, enabling them to archive, publish, and share research outputs, including software, data, and documents, more easily and efficiently. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how CERN researchers manage and disseminate their work.
Your responsibilities

• Develop and maintain web applications using Python on the backend and React on the frontend and implement new features to support the archiving, publication, and sharing of research outputs.

• Contribute to the migration of existing content to a new digital platform, ensuring data quality and consistency.

• Write, test, and review code to ensure reliability, performance, and maintainability.

• Collaborate with software engineers and end users to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

• Document technical solutions and contribute to user and developer documentation.

• Learn and apply best practices in software engineering, version control, and agile teamwork.
Your profile

• Experience with Python and web application development (for example using Flask or similar frameworks).

• Basic knowledge of JavaScript and modern web interfaces (for example React or similar libraries).

• Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

• Ability to write clear, maintainable code and learn new technologies.

• Experience with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL.

• Familiarity with search or indexing technologies, such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

• Exposure to container technologies, such as Docker, and container platforms (for example OpenShift).

• Experience contributing to or working with open-source software projects.
Skills

• Python, Flask, JavaScript, React, Git skills are required.

• PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch skills are advantageous.

• Docker, OpenShift skills are advantageous.

• Experience working on open source projects is advantageous.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Software Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-November-2026
Job reference: IT-CA-IR-2026-99-GRAE
Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. descriptionByLocale.en:
During the ATLAS Phase-II upgrade in Long Shutdown 3, an all-silicon Inner Tracker (ITk) will be installed, consisting of four silicon strip layers and five hybrid pixel layers. The detector will provide exceptional radiation hardness and fast charged-particle reconstruction. The CERN ATL-TRK team contributes to the ITk pixel detector construction through the assembly, testing, and integration of hybrid pixel detector modules and their further integration into the detector.
Your responsibilities

• Assemble and test silicon pixel detector modules used in particle physics experiments.

• Support and improve production processes to achieve and maintain high throughput levels.

• Contribute to increasing the parallelisation of testing procedures in laboratory environments.

• Develop and maintain in-house software tools to optimise workflows and analyse test data.

• Work with databases to record, track, and evaluate measurement results.

• Present progress and results to internal teams and the wider project community.

• Assist in upgrading laboratory equipment and procedures to meet evolving project requirements.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, physicists, and technicians in a multidisciplinary team.

• Contribute to the integration of assembled detector modules into larger sub-systems of the ATLAS ITk Pixel detector.
Your profile

• Experience with the assembly, testing, and characterisation of silicon detector modules or similar systems.

• Practical experience with laboratory instrumentation such as probe stations, metrology systems, or optical inspection instruments.

• Ability to perform quality control measurements and evaluate results with attention to accuracy and repeatability.

• Experience in automating laboratory procedures and data acquisition using programming languages such as Python.

• Familiarity with data analysis, database tools, and documentation systems used in detector production or similar environments.

• Experience working in large, international research collaborations and contributing to common infrastructure or shared facilities.

• Demonstrated ability to plan, prioritise and deliver results under tight schedules in a production environment.
Skills

• Knowledge of silicon tracking detectors for high energy physics experiments.

• Experience in handling silicon detector modules and required laboratory equipment.

• Experience with common programming languages such as Python.

• Knowledge of data analysis and evaluation for silicon detector modules.

• Organised, accurate and independent approach to work.

• Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and international collaborations.

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics or Electronics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 14.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job reference: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-116-GRAP
Field of work: Experimental Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

Lors de la mise à niveau ATLAS Phase-II dans Long Shutdown 3, un traqueur intérieur tout-silicien (ITk) sera installé, composé de quatre couches de lames de silicium et de cinq couches de pixel hybrides. Le détecteur fournira une dureté de rayonnement exceptionnelle et une reconstruction rapide des particules chargées. L'équipe du CERN ATL-TRK contribue à la construction du détecteur de pixel ITk par l'assemblage, l'essai et l'intégration de modules de détecteurs de pixel hybrides et leur intégration au détecteur. • Assembler et tester des modules de détecteurs de pixel de silicium utilisés dans les expériences de physique des particules.
• Soutenir et améliorer les processus de production pour atteindre et maintenir des niveaux de rendement élevés.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join the Cooling and Ventilation developers team within CERN's Engineering Department (EN), where you will contribute to the development, commissioning, and maintenance of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and automation solutions essential to the operation of CERN's accelerators, detectors, and infrastructure.
As part of a multidisciplinary team of technicians and engineers, you will be involved in the specification, design, commissioning, and maintenance of a wide range of ICS dedicated to cooling and ventilation plants for accelerator facilities, experimental areas, and technical infrastructure.
This position offers the opportunity to work on large-scale industrial installations in a highly technical and collaborative environment.
Your responsibilities

• Gather control system requirements and compile all relevant technical documentation.

• Design automation solutions and control systems for Industrial ventilation and cooling plants.

• Develop and implement PLC applications for ICS.

• Define and execute tests of ICS on simulators.

• Perform on-site commissioning of ICS.

• Design, implement, and deploy improvements and corrective actions for operational control systems.
More information here .
Your profile

• Proven experience in Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programming.

• Good knowledge of PLC development based on the IEC 61131 standard.

• Initial experience in Python programming or other high-level programming languages.

• Ability to read and work with electrical schematics.

• Initial experience in the configuration, programming, and operation of SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems.

• Understanding of industrial automation principles and control systems.

• Experience with SCADA systems in an industrial environment is considered an advantage.

• Knowledge of automation theory and industrial process control is considered an advantage.
Skills

• PLC programming using SIEMENS Step7, TIA Portal and/or Schneider Control Expert.

• High-level programming languages (e.g. Python).

• Version control software systems (e.g. Git).

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Automation and Controls (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

• Applicants without University degree are not eligible.

• Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 12.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.
Job reference: EN-CV-CL-2026-171-GRAE
Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 5266-5793 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a member of our team, you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and operational support of CERN's cryogenics process control systems. You will play an active role in major consolidation projects carried out during Long Shutdown 3, supporting the cryogenic infrastructure of the LHC accelerator as well as the ATLAS and CMS detectors.
This diverse role combines software development, hardware installation, and system integration activities. You will collaborate closely with a wide range of CERN services and work alongside the Cryogenics Operations team to deliver reliable and innovative solutions that support world-leading scientific research.
Your responsibilities:

• Contribute to the design, development, implementation and commissioning of control systems, using automated software production methods based on GitLab CI and CERN control frameworks.

• Contribute to the review and propose improvements of process control logic.

• Participate in the installation and commissioning of control hardware on site.

• Participate to the maintenance and insertion of control system's configuration data in CERN's databases.

• Cooperate with CERN's service providers to resolve issues and share best practices.
Your profile:

• Experience in Python and bash programming.

• Proficiency in code refactoring, optimisation, and testing.

• Experience with relational databases (Oracle), data manipulation and SQL.

• Knowledge of code versioning systems (Git), issue tracking (Jira) and continuous integration (GitLab CI).

• Basic experience with PLC-based control systems (Siemens, Schneider).

• Ability to understand and analyse systems, identify issues and propose solutions.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computing Engineering or Automation Engineering or a related field.
Skills:

• Python, Bash, Git, Jira.

• Relational databases, SQL.

• DevOps, Continuous Integration.

• Process controls, PLC programming (SCL).

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Computing or Automation Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 11.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Hybrid
Target start date: 01-September-2026
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: TE-CRG-IC-2026-96-GRAP
Field of work: Software Engineering and IT
Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione: Il team di coordinamento tecnico ALICE si sta espandendo per affrontare l'aumento del carico di lavoro di ingegneria meccanica associato al programmato Large Hadron Collider (LHC) lunghi periodi di shutdown nel 2026-2028 (LS3) e 2033-2034 (LS4), tra cui attività di decommissione e installazione del rivelatore, lo sviluppo del tutto nuovo rilevatore ALICE 3, e la preparazione di future infrastrutture di rivelatore. In qualità di ingegnere meccanico, contribuirai all'esecuzione delle attività di installazione LS3 e alla progettazione e costruzione del sistema di rilevatori ALICE 3, lavorando in un team multidisciplinare di ingegneri, tecnici e designer. Funzioni:
• Partecipa al programma di aggiornamento del rivelatore ALICE per LS3, in particolare l'installazione del nuovo tubo del fascio, del tracker di silicio e del calorimetro in avanti.
• Fornire supporto tecnico e supervisione in loco presso il sito sperimentale durante i periodi di manutenzione programmati.
• Fornire supporto ingegneristico per il programma di aggiornamento ALICE3 per LS4: definizione del layout degli esperimenti, compresa l'integrazione di rivelatori, servizi e tutte le infrastrutture correlate.

Introduction:
The ALICE Technical Coordination team is expanding to address the increased mechanical-engineering workload associated with the scheduled Large Hadron Collider (LHC) Long Shutdown periods in 2026-2028 (LS3) and 2033-2034 (LS4), including detector decommissioning and installation activities, the development of the entirely new ALICE 3 detector, and the preparation of future detector infrastructure.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the execution of LS3 installation activities and the design and construction of the ALICE 3 detector system, working within a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, and designers.
Functions:

• Participate in the ALICE detector upgrade programme for LS3, specifically the installation of the new beam pipe, silicon tracker and forward calorimeter.

• Provide mechanical engineering support and on-site supervision at the experiment site during the programmed maintenance periods.

• Provide engineering support for the ALICE3 upgrade programme for LS4: definition of the experiment layout including integration of detectors, services, and all the related infrastructure.

• Design detector standard metallic and carbon-composite structures, supported by structural analyses to assess performance under mechanical, thermal, and dynamic loads using appropriate material models and failure criteria, ensuring strength, stability, and compliance with safety requirements.

• Work closely with stakeholders, including detector experts, collaboration members, external companies and technical support teams from CERN and ALICE collaborating institutes.

• Support the ALICE Technical Coordination team in supervising designers and technicians during the daily work.

• Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience:

• Experience in the design, construction, and assembly of mechanical systems.

• Proven experience in the use of CATIA for CAD design.

• Knowledge of ANSYS for structural analysis.

• Experience working in a multidisciplinary team, including supervision of technical engineers and technicians.

• Proven ability to coordinate work done by external companies and contractors.
Technical competencies:

• Design and analysis of mechanical structures.

• Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in solid mechanics.

• Knowledge and application of non-metallic composites.

• Production of 2D drawings and 3D models.

• Organisation, planning and control: , coordination of activities involving different technical fields (mechanical work, metallic structures, heavy handling etc.).
Behavioural competencies:

• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.

• Managing Self: working well autonomously; taking on activities and tasks without prompting

• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily accepting new tasks or work/projects.

• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.

• Demonstrating Accountability: taking responsibility for own actions and decisions.
Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:
Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 10.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Employment Conditions:
Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite
This position involves:

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Job grade: 6-7
Job reference: EP-ALI-TC-2026-127-LD
Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Engineer

Global Benefits

• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!
More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.it:
I rilevatori di particelle operanti negli esperimenti del CERN Large Hadron Collider richiedono miscele di gas altamente specifiche, precise e stabili, fornite da sistemi di gas dedicati e complessi spesso operanti nella ricircolo del gas. La composizione corretta e stabile della miscela è un requisito fondamentale per il funzionamento continuo e a lungo termine di tutti i rivelatori. Ti unirai al team Gas Systems nell'EP-DT-GD, responsabile della manutenzione, del funzionamento e dello sviluppo dei sistemi di gas per i rilevatori di particelle. Il team è responsabile di circa 40 sistemi di gas che forniscono le miscele richieste ai rilevatori di particelle in tutti gli esperimenti CERN. In determinate condizioni, i rilevatori di particelle negli esperimenti LHC utilizzano gas serra (GHGs). Il CERN è fortemente impegnato a ridurre le emissioni di GHG dal funzionamento dei rilevatori di particelle. Il team Gas Systems ha individuato quattro strategie per ottimizzare l'utilizzo del GHG: ricircolo del gas, recupero del gas, nuovi gas ecocompatibili e abbattimento del gas. Le tue responsabilità
• Partecipazione attiva al funzionamento, manutenzione e aggiornamenti tecnici dei sistemi di gas per uno degli esperimenti LHC, garantendo un funzionamento continuo e stabile.
• Partecipazione al servizio "piquet" (stand-by duty), fornendo supporto tecnico e rapido intervento per garantire l'affidabilità operativa 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 dei sistemi di gas durante le operazioni di LHC.
• Contributo agli studi R&D finalizzati all'individuazione di sostituzioni per i gas serra attualmente utilizzati (GHGs), come R134a e SF6.
• Contributo e responsabilità per il funzionamento delle configurazioni di prova in laboratorio e nelle strutture del CERN, dove si può simulare lo sfondo ad alta frequenza previsto durante la fase LHC ad alta luminosità.
• Convalida della compatibilità di nuovi gas eco-friendly con i componenti utilizzati nella costruzione del sistema di gas, garantendo nessun impatto sulle prestazioni del rivelatore.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Particle detectors operating at CERN's Large Hadron Collider experiments require highly specific, precise, and stable gas mixtures, provided by dedicated and complex gas systems often operating in gas recirculation. Correct and stable mixture composition is a fundamental requirement for the long-term, continuous operation of all detectors.
You will join the Gas Systems team in the EP-DT-GD, responsible for the maintenance, operation and development of the gas systems for particle detectors. The team is responsible for approximately 40 gas systems delivering the required mixtures to the particle detectors across all CERN experiments.
Under certain conditions, particle detectors in the LHC experiments use greenhouse gases (GHGs). CERN is strongly committed to reducing GHG emissions from the operation of particle detectors. The Gas Systems team has identified four strategies to optimise GHG usage: gas recirculation, gas recuperation, new environmentally friendly gases and gas abatement.
Your responsibilities

• Active involvement in the operation, maintenance, and technical upgrades of gas systems for one of the LHC experiments, ensuring continuous and stable operation.

• Participation in the "piquet" (stand-by duty) service, providing technical support and rapid intervention to ensure 24/7 operational reliability of gas systems during LHC runs.

• Contribution to R&D studies aimed at identifying replacements for currently used greenhouse gases (GHGs), such as R134a and SF6.

• Contribution to and responsibility for the operation of test setups in the laboratory and at CERN facilities, where the high-radiation background expected during the High-Luminosity LHC phase can be simulated.

• Validation of the compatibility of new eco-friendly gases with components used in gas system construction, ensuring no impact on detector performance.

• You will learn about gaseous detectors, gas systems, gas recirculation, and gas recuperation.

• This role includes team supervision responsibilities.

Your profile

• Experience in operating different types of gaseous detectors.

• Experience in the design, operation, or maintenance of gas systems.

• Practical knowledge of industrial instrumentation and sensors.

• Experience in operating gaseous detectors in high-radiation environments and with eco-gases.

• Ability to perform technical interventions in experimental areas.
Skills

• Understanding of gaseous particle detector operation and radiation effects.

• Operation of gaseous detectors with eco-gas mixtures.

• Knowledge of gas distribution systems.

• Familiarity with gas analysis techniques (gas chromatography) and leak detection methods.

• Proactive approach to identifying potential system weaknesses before they lead to operational downtime.

• Ability and willingness to work in a variety of environments, from high-tech laboratories to underground experimental caverns, and to adapt to changing priorities during LHC technical stops and data-taking periods.

• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
Eligibility criteria:

• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .

• You have a professional background in Physics or Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;

• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 10.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.
Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
Working hours: 40 hours per week
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Target start date: 01-October-2026
This position involves:

• Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays.

• Work in Radiation Areas.

• Interventions in underground installations.

• A valid driving licence.

• Radiation worker, category A.

• Exposure to risk of falling from heights during scaffolding assembly and dismantling operations.

• Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.
Job reference: EP-DT-GD-2026-114-GRAP
Field of work: Applied Physics
Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist

Global Benefits

• A monthly stipend between 6372-7004 Swiss Francs per month (tax free) depending on your degree.

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.

• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.

• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.

• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

• On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!
At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART!

Die richtige und stabile Gemischzusammensetzung ist eine grundlegende Voraussetzung für den langfristigen, kontinuierlichen Betrieb aller Detektoren. Sie werden dem Team von Gas Systems in der EP-DT-GD beitreten, das für die Wartung, den Betrieb und die Entwicklung der Gassysteme für Partikeldetektoren verantwortlich ist. Das Team ist für etwa 40 Gassysteme verantwortlich, die die erforderlichen Mischungen zu den Teilchendetektoren in allen CERN-Experimenten liefern. Unter bestimmten Bedingungen verwenden Teilchendetektoren in den LHC-Experimenten Treibhausgase (GHGs). CERN setzt sich stark dafür ein, die Treibhausgasemissionen aus dem Betrieb von Partikeldetektoren zu reduzieren. Les détecteurs de particules utilisés dans les expériences du CERN sur le grand collisionneur à hadron nécessitent des mélanges de gaz très spécifiques, précis et stables, fournis par des systèmes de gaz spécialisés et complexes fonctionnant souvent en recirculation de gaz. La composition correcte et stable du mélange est une exigence fondamentale pour le fonctionnement continu à long terme de tous les détecteurs. Vous rejoindrez l'équipe des systèmes de gaz de l'EP-DT-GD, responsable de la maintenance, de l'exploitation et du développement des systèmes de gaz pour les détecteurs de particules. L'équipe est responsable d'environ 40 systèmes à gaz fournissant les mélanges requis aux détecteurs de particules dans toutes les expériences du CERN. Dans certaines conditions, les détecteurs de particules utilisés dans les expériences LHC utilisent des gaz à effet de serre (GES). Le CERN est fermement déterminé à réduire les émissions de GES résultant du fonctionnement des détecteurs de particules. L'équipe des systèmes de gaz a défini quatre stratégies pour optimiser l'utilisation des GES : la recirculation des gaz, la récupération des gaz, de nouveaux gaz respectueux de l'environnement et la réduction des gaz. Vos responsabilités
• Participation active à l'exploitation, à la maintenance et à la mise à niveau technique des systèmes de gaz pour l'une des expériences LHC, assurant un fonctionnement continu et stable.

• Contribution à des études de R-D visant à identifier les remplacements des gaz à effet de serre (GES) actuellement utilisés, tels que R134a et SF6.
• Contribution et responsabilité pour le fonctionnement des installations d'essai dans le laboratoire et dans les installations du CERN, où l'arrière-plan de rayonnement élevé attendu pendant la phase de LHC à haute luminosité peut être simulé.

• Capacité à effectuer des interventions techniques dans des domaines expérimentaux. Compétences
• Connaissance du fonctionnement du détecteur de particules gazeuses et des effets des rayonnements.
• Utilisation de détecteurs gazeux avec des mélanges écogaz.
• Connaissance des systèmes de distribution de gaz.
