Introduzione Unisciti alla sezione Cabling come tecnico elettrico e gioca un ruolo chiave nell'espansione, nel rafforzamento e nel mantenimento delle installazioni di cavi di controllo e di potenza del CERN. Il vostro lavoro supporterà sistemi essenziali all'interno degli acceleratori del CERN, come sistemi di allarme, sistemi di controllo del processo, strumentazione del fascio e sistemi di alimentazione magnete. Funzioni
• Analizzare le richieste di installazione del cavo e liaizzare con i richiedenti per ottenere qualsiasi informazione mancante.
• Condurre gli studi necessari tra cui la definizione dei tipi di cavi, l'assemblaggio dei connettori, le convenzioni dei fili, il routing e i supporti meccanici, in collaborazione con gli utenti e considerando i vincoli dell'ambiente di lavoro.
• Creare bollette di quantità e budget.
• Organizzare campagne di cablaggio e de-cabling con stakeholder di coordinamento esterni e interni (ad esempio appaltatori, servizi di trasporto e gestione, team di coordinamento).
• Assicurare la preparazione della documentazione di lavoro dettagliata (ad esempio, disegni, elenchi di cavi, procedure di montaggio dei connettori, procedure di prova).
• Effettuare valutazioni dei rischi relative all'esecuzione dei lavori di cablaggio, identificare potenziali pericoli e definire misure di mitigazione per garantire la sicurezza e il rispetto degli standard CERN.
• Gestire la logistica necessaria per le attività di cablaggio, come la consegna del materiale, la configurazione di ponteggio e l'accesso del sito.
• Organizzare e gestire le riunioni del cantiere.
• Monitorare e segnalare i progressi, la sicurezza e la qualità delle opere.
• Eseguire l'ispezione, il test e l'accettazione del lavoro completato. Certificato tecnico o istruzione secondaria generale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'installazione elettrica industriale o in un campo relativo. Esperienza:
• Esperienza dimostrata nella pianificazione, preparazione e supervisione delle attività di cablaggio elettrico industriale, compresa l'attuazione delle procedure di lockout/tagout (LOTO).
• Forte esperienza con cavi di controllo e di alimentazione, compresi i loro connettori.
• Esperienza nella verifica della qualità tecnica e della conformità degli impianti di cablaggio con norme e specifiche applicabili.
• Esperienza nella supervisione tecnica degli appaltatori. Competenze tecniche:
• Progettazione e produzione di cavi e connettori ad alta tensione.
• Progettazione, costruzione, messa in servizio e manutenzione di sistemi di cavi elettrici.
• Progettazione e produzione di cavi e connettori a bassa e alta tensione. Competenze comportamentali:
• Risultati: lavoro di guida / progetti lungo e vederli attraverso alla loro conclusione.
• Comunicare efficacemente: ascoltare attivamente gli altri e far parlare gli altri.
• Gestire il Sé: prendere iniziativa oltre i compiti regolari e fare accadere le cose.
• Risolvere i problemi: anticipare gli ostacoli; valutare soluzioni alternative per avere un piano di riduzione.
• Lavorare in team: costruire e mantenere relazioni di lavoro costruttive ed efficaci. Capacità linguistiche: Parlato e scritto inglese o francese, con un impegno per imparare l'altra lingua. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il prima possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 09.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST. Condizioni di lavoro Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido Questa posizione comporta:
• Lavoro nelle aree di radiazione.
• Interventi in impianti sotterranei.
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavoro a turni, servizio stand-by e lavoro durante le notti, la domenica e le festività ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione. Grado di lavoro: 3-4 Riferimento del lavoro: EN-EL-CS-2025-277-LD Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria elettrica o elettronica Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Tecnico meccanico Vantaggi globali
• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction Join the Cabling Section as an electrical technician, and play a key role in expanding, strengthening, and maintaining CERN’s control and power cable installations. Your work will support essential systems within the CERN accelerators, such as alarm systems, process control systems, beam instrumentation, and magnet powering systems. Functions
• Analyse cable installation requests and liaising with requesters to obtain any missing information.
• Conduct the necessary studies including the definition of the cable types, the connectors assembly, the wire conventions, the routing and the mechanical supports, in collaboration with users and considering the constraints of the work environment.
• Create bills of quantities and budgets.
• Organise cabling and de-cabling campaigns with external and internal coordination stakeholders (i.e contractors, transport and handling service, coordination team).
• Ensure the preparation of detailed work documentation (e.g., drawings, cable lists, connector assembly procedures, test procedures).
• Carry out risk assessments related to the execution of cabling work, identifying potential hazards and defining mitigation measures to ensure safety and compliance with CERN standards.
• Manage the logistics required for cabling activities, such as material delivery, scaffolding setup, and site access.
• Organise and manage worksite meetings.
• Monitor and report the progress, the safety and the quality of the works.
• Perform inspection, testing and acceptance of completed work. Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Industrial Electrical Installation or a related field. Experience:
• Demonstrated experience in planning, preparing, and overseeing industrial electrical cabling activities, including the implementation of lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.
• Strong experience with control and power cables, including their connectors.
• Experience in verifying the technical quality and compliance of cabling installations with applicable standards and specifications.
• Experience in technical supervision of contractors. Technical competencies:
• Design and manufacturing of high-voltage cables and connectors.
• Design, construction, commissioning, and maintenance of electrical cable systems.
• Design and manufacturing of low and high-voltage cables and connectors. Behavioural competencies:
• Achieving Results: driving work / projects along and seeing them through to their conclusion.
• Communicating Effectively: listening actively to others and letting others speak.
• Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.
• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
• Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships. Language skills: Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language. Eligibility and closing date: Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organisation. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States . This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 09.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST. Employment Conditions Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position. Working Hours: 40 hours per week Job Flexibility: Hybrid This position involves:
• Work in Radiation Areas.
• Interventions in underground installations.
• A valid driving licence.
• Shift work, stand-by duty, and work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organisation. Job grade: 3-4 Job reference: EN-EL-CS-2025-277-LD Field of work: Electrical or Electronics Engineering Benchmark Job Title: Mechanical Technician Global Benefits
• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure. Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive. Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART! More information about us, here: careers.cern

Einleitung Treten Sie als Elektrotechniker der Verkabelungsabteilung bei und spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Erweiterung, Stärkung und Wartung der Steuerungs- und Stromkabelinstallationen des CERN. Ihre Arbeit unterstützt wesentliche Systeme innerhalb der CERN-Beschleuniger, wie Alarmsysteme, Prozessleitsysteme, Strahlinstrumentierung und Magnetantriebssysteme. Funktionen
• Analysieren Sie Kabelinstallationsanfragen und arbeiten Sie mit Anfragenden zusammen, um fehlende Informationen zu erhalten.
• Führen Sie die erforderlichen Studien durch, einschließlich der Definition der Kabeltypen, der Zusammenstellung der Steckverbinder, der Drahtkonventionen, des Routings und der mechanischen Unterstützung, in Zusammenarbeit mit den Benutzern und unter Berücksichtigung der Einschränkungen der Arbeitsumgebung.
• Erstellen Sie Rechnungen von Mengen und Budgets.
• Organisation von Verkabelungs- und Entkabelungskampagnen mit externen und internen Koordinierungsakteuren (d. h. Auftragnehmern, Transport- und Abfertigungsdienst, Koordinationsteam).
• Gewährleistung der Erstellung detaillierter Arbeitsdokumentationen (z. B. Zeichnungen, Kabellisten, Verfahren für die Steckverbindermontage, Prüfverfahren).
• Durchführung von Risikobewertungen im Zusammenhang mit der Durchführung von Verkabelungsarbeiten, Ermittlung potenzieller Gefahren und Festlegung von Minderungsmaßnahmen zur Gewährleistung der Sicherheit und Einhaltung der CERN-Standards.
• Verwalten Sie die Logistik, die für Verkabelungsaktivitäten erforderlich ist, wie Materiallieferung, Gerüsteinrichtung und Standortzugang.
• Organisieren und verwalten Sie Arbeitstreffen.
• Überwachung und Berichterstattung über den Fortschritt, die Sicherheit und die Qualität der Arbeiten.
• Durchführung von Inspektionen, Tests und Abnahme abgeschlossener Arbeiten. Technisches Zertifikat oder allgemeine Sekundarschulbildung oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der industriellen Elektroinstallation oder einem verwandten Gebiet. Erfahrung:

• Starke Erfahrung mit Steuer- und Stromkabeln, einschließlich ihrer Steckverbinder.
• Erfahrung bei der Überprüfung der technischen Qualität und der Einhaltung der geltenden Normen und Spezifikationen durch Verkabelungsanlagen.
• Erfahrung in der technischen Überwachung von Auftragnehmern. Technische Kompetenzen:
• Entwurf und Herstellung von Hochspannungskabeln und -steckern.
• Entwurf, Bau, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung von elektrischen Kabelsystemen.
• Entwurf und Herstellung von Nieder- und Hochspannungskabeln und -steckern. Verhaltenskompetenzen:

Sprachkenntnisse: Gesprochen und geschrieben Englisch oder Französisch, mit der Verpflichtung, die andere Sprache zu lernen. Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag: Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Job Grade: 3-4 Arbeitsnummer: EN-EL-CS-2025-277-LD Arbeitsgebiet: Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik Benchmark Job Title: Mechaniker Globale Vorteile
• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.

• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.

Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione Il CERN sta preparando il progetto Future Circular Collider (FCC) per una decisione potenziale da parte del Consiglio CERN su una scala temporale del 2028. Data la sua dimensione, la complessità e l'impronta territoriale, la FCC richiede un impegno forte, credibile e continuo con gli Stati ospitanti di Francia e Svizzera a tutti i livelli istituzionali. Per sostenere l'attuazione territoriale del progetto FCC, il CERN sta cercando un professionista senior con una comprovata esperienza nella fornitura di progetti infrastrutturali su larga scala, preferibilmente in Francia e/o in Svizzera, tra cui autorizzazioni normative, procedure ambientali, questioni attinenti alla terra e coordinamento con gli enti nazionali e regionali. La posizione è incorporata nell'ambito del CERN Stakeholder Relations Sector e dell'Ufficio del Progetto FCC. Assicura che l'impegno territoriale e tutti i processi normativi e amministrativi con gli Stati ospitanti siano anticipati, strutturati e allineati con la pianificazione generale del progetto e la gestione dei rischi. La posizione si riferisce direttamente al Direttore Generale del CERN per le interazioni con gli Stati ospitanti e opera in stretto coordinamento con il Direttore del Settore Relazioni Stakeholder e il Leader del Progetto FCC. Il reporting amministrativo è attraverso il Settore Relazioni Stakeholder. Funzioni In qualità di capo della FCC Attuazione territoriale e Relazioni di Stato ospitante, Lei:
• Atto come punto di ingresso unico del CERN con le autorità di Stato ospitante in Francia e Svizzera per tutte le questioni territoriali della FCC, che si confrontano con le autorità nazionali, regionali e locali, comprese le prefetture, le autorità cantonali e gli organi amministrativi competenti.
• Fornire una leadership strategica generale per l'impegno di FCC Host State, garantendo coerenza, continuità e credibilità nelle posizioni del CERN nei confronti delle autorità di Stato ospitante.
• Definire e guidare la strategia per le approvazioni normative, i processi di autorizzazione e le vie amministrative necessarie per la FCC.
• Sostenere la preparazione e la progressione delle valutazioni di impatto ambientale, delle indagini pubbliche e delle procedure associate.
• Assicurare l'allineamento dei processi territoriali e regolamentari con il programma di progetto FCC, la gestione dei rischi e lo sviluppo tecnico, in collaborazione permanente con l'Ufficio Progetti FCC.
• Sostegno e coordinamento dei processi legati alla terra, vincoli territoriali e questioni amministrative relative al sito.

Introduction CERN is preparing the Future Circular Collider (FCC) project for a potential decision by the CERN Council on a 2028 timescale. Given its scale, complexity and territorial footprint, the FCC requires strong, credible and continuous engagement with the Host States of France and Switzerland at all institutional levels. To support the territorial implementation of the FCC project, CERN is seeking a senior professional with proven experience in the delivery of large-scale infrastructure projects, preferably in France and/or Switzerland, including regulatory authorisations, environmental procedures, land-related matters, and coordination with national and regional authorities. The position is embedded within the CERN Stakeholder Relations Sector and the FCC Project Office. It ensures that territorial engagement and all regulatory and administrative processes with Host States are anticipated, structured and aligned with the overall project schedule and risk management. The position reports directly to the CERN Director-General for interactions with the Host States and operates in close coordination with the Director of the Stakeholder Relations Sector and the FCC Project Leader. Administrative reporting is through the Stakeholder Relations Sector.   Functions As Head of FCC Territorial Implementation and Host State Relations, you will:
• Act as CERN's single-entry point with Host State authorities in France and Switzerland for all FCC territorial matters, interfacing with national, regional and local authorities, including Prefectures, Cantonal authorities and relevant administrative bodies.
• Provide overall strategic leadership for FCC Host State engagement, ensuring consistency, continuity and credibility in CERN's positions vis-à-vis Host State authorities.
• Define and steer the strategy for regulatory approvals, authorisation processes and administrative pathways required for the FCC.
• Support the preparation and progression of environmental impact assessments, public inquiries and associated procedures.
• Ensure alignment of territorial and regulatory processes with the FCC project schedule, risk management, and technical development, in permanent collaboration with the FCC Project Office.
• Support and coordinate land-related processes, territorial constraints and site-related administrative matters.
• Identify territorial and regulatory risks, advising the FCC Project Leader and CERN senior management on mitigation measures and sequencing.
• Represent CERN in high-level meetings with Host State authorities on FCC territorial implementation topics.
• Ensure that CERN senior management receives timely strategic insight on territorial risks, constraints and opportunities.
• Ensure that public dialogue and consultation processes are conducted credibly, transparently and effectively.
• This role ensures that institutional engagement, regulatory processes and project implementation progress in a coordinated and mutually reinforcing manner. Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Public Administration, Civil Engineering, Law, Political Science, Environmental Governance, Territorial Planning or a related field. Experience:
• Senior-level experience with direct responsibility for the territorial, administrative and regulatory implementation of at least one large-scale infrastructure project of comparable scope and complexity, preferably in France and/or Switzerland.
• Proven successful experience working with national and regional authorities, regulatory bodies, and complex multi-stakeholder environments.
• Demonstrated involvement in public dialogue or consultation processes for projects with significant environmental or societal impact.
• Strong understanding of French and/or Swiss administrative and regulatory frameworks. Technical competencies:
• Project management.
• Stakeholder relationship management.
• Risk management.
• Implementation of vision and strategic agility.
• Strategic communications planning, and utilising effective negotiation techniques to achieve long-term results acceptable to all parties involved. Behavioural competencies:
• Creating Vision and Strategic Partnerships: strategic judgement in complex institutional environments.
• Building Relationships: credibility and authority when interacting with senior public officials.
• Solving problems: ability to anticipate constraints and structure robust solutions.
• Leading with Strength and Credibility: strong coordination and integration skills.
• Communicating Effectively: excellent communication, representation and negotiation abilities. Language skills: Spoken and written both English and French. Eligibility and closing date: Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States . This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 08.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST . Employment Conditions Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position. Working Hours: 40 hours per week Job Flexibility: Fully Onsite This position involves:
• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization. Job grade: 8 Job reference: SR-SE-2026-125-LD Field of work: International Relations Benchmark Job Title: Communications/Public Relations /External Relations Professional Global Benefits
• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure. Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive. Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART! More information about us, here: careers.cern

descriptionByLocale.en:
You will join a team that is responsible for the development and evolution of CERN's industrial control frameworks, JCOP and UNICOS, as well as for evaluating and validating new technologies for future control systems. These frameworks build on the commercial SCADA platform SIMATIC WinCC Open Architecture (WinCC OA) from Siemens, which forms the backbone of more than 800 mission-critical control systems. Starting in a few months, the LHC detectors will undergo major upgrades requiring new control systems and additional functionality in the JCOP Framework. In this context, you will contribute to the development and evolution of the JCOP Framework and support the implementation of detector control systems. Your responsibilities
• Contribute to the development and evolution of the JCOP Framework used by the LHC experiments.
• Implement and maintain software components, templates and tools based on WinCC OA and CERN control frameworks.
• Integrate devices into supervisory control systems.
• Design & Development of user interfaces with WinCC OA.
• Prototype and test new solutions to improve reliability, maintainability and scalability of the frameworks.
• Assist LHC experiments in the development, deployment and maintenance of their control systems.
• Participate in code reviews, debugging and troubleshooting of control system applications. Your profile
• Experience or exposure to software development in distributed or modular systems.
• Experience with modern programming languages and development tools (e.g. C/C++ or similar).
• Knowledge of software engineering principles (version control GIT, testing, code quality, documentation, CI/CD).
• Knowledge of Qt, Node.js or TypeScript would be an advantage.
• Familiarity with industrial control systems, SCADA technologies, or CERN experiment online systems would be an advantage. Skills
• Proficiency in C/C++ programming.
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks quickly.
• Ability to design, implement and debug software components in complex systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and interact with engineers and scientists.
• Good communication and documentation skills.
• Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language. Eligibility criteria:
• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
• You have a professional background in Software Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before. Job closing date: 08.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST. Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum. descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction:
 You will contribute to the design, development, testing and maintenance of the Data Processing Platform (DPP), used for both offline and online analysis of accelerator and beam data. Working within the Agile Data Processing team of the CERN Controls Software & Services group, you will help build reliable and scalable backend services supporting the control, monitoring and analysis of particle accelerators and equipment.

You will participate in the validation and evolution of the platform architecture, develop production-ready integrations, and contribute to the modernisation of existing services through the migration of legacy systems to the DPP.
 Functions:

• Design, develop, and maintain mission-critical software components for the DPP.

• Conduct technological watch and evaluate emerging technologies to ensure high-quality solutions aligned with CERN’s evolving accelerator controls environment.

• Collaborate with stakeholders, including end users, Product Owners, and infrastructure providers, to gather requirements and define solutions.

• Support accelerator equipment experts, physicists, and operation crews by improving and optimising their experience with the platform and associated software services.

Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or a related field.
 Experience:

• Proven solid experience in software development using Java .

• Hands-on experience with  Python .

• Strong knowledge of the Spring Framework ecosystem.

• Practical experience with concurrent and multi-threaded programming.

• Good understanding of distributed systems and JVM internals.

• Experience applying software quality assurance practices and related tools.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test, and deployment workflows.

• Experience with cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, is highly desirable; familiarity with Knative or similar framework would be considered an asset.
 Technical competencies:

• Knowledge of programming techniques and languages: design dependable software services. following SOLID principles or similar.

• Architecture and design of ICT systems: designing scalable services and APIs.

• Identification and selection of relevant emerging ICT technologies.

• Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.
 Behavioural competencies:

• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.

• Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.

• Working in Teams: contributing to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addressing issues.

• Solving Problems: adopting a pragmatic approach; understanding the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
 Language skills:

• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

 Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States .
 This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 07.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The n_TOF facility  at CERN provides high-intensity, wide-energy neutron beams for high-precision studies in nuclear astrophysics and medical applications. This position will focus on simulation studies with the aim of optimising the facilities performance. You will contribute to neutronics validation and benchmarking of the latest neutron data libraries. The work will include the redesign of a collimation system as well as the design of a dedicated neutron transmission measurement station. You will also have the opportunity to gain experience in the operations experimental facilities as part of the local support team for n_TOF.  Your responsibilities
• Simulation studies for n_TOF facility physics performance optimisation and future program.
• Redesign of a collimation system as well as the design of a dedicated neutron transmission measurement station.
• Quantifying and mitigating secondary radiation through optimised shielding configurations and design modifications.
• Use of FLUKA for advanced Monte Carlo modelling, including refinement of low-energy neutron transport, such as self-shielding effects in the unresolved resonance region and Doppler broadening corrections.
• Neutronics validation and benchmarking of the latest neutron data libraries. Your profile
• Experience in using Monte Carlo transport codes for physics experiments.
• Experience performing studies in the field of neutron physics / neutronics. Skills
• Neutron physics knowledge.
• Monte Carlo simulation.
• Fluka knowledge would be an advantage.
• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French. Eligibility criteria:
• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
• You have a professional background in Physics (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
• You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before. Job closing date: 06.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST. Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum. Working hours: 40 hours per week Job flexibility: Hybrid Target start date: 01-September-2026 This position involves:
• Work in Radiation Areas.
• Interventions in underground installations.
• Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization. Job reference: SY-STI-BMP-2026-103-GRAP Field of work: Applied Physics Benchmark job: 200140 - Applied Physicist Global Benefits

• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
• A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
• Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.

Stiamo offrendo una posizione all'interno dell'ATLAS Experiment al CERN, contribuendo allo sviluppo e al funzionamento di Rucio, un sistema di gestione dei dati scientifici open source ampiamente utilizzato che supporta alcune delle più grandi collaborazioni scientifiche del mondo. Esperimenti come ATLAS, CMS, Belle II, SKA, DUNE, e altri si affidano a Rucio per gestire i dati distribuiti a livello globale su scala multi-exabyte. Rucio è sviluppato in tutto il settore Ricerca e Computing del CERN all'interno della sezione EP-ATL-CO, che si concentra sull'estensione, l'integrazione e il funzionamento del sistema a supporto dell'ATLAS Experiment. Si unirà a un team di ingegneri software e specialisti di calcolo che lavorano sulla gestione dei dati scientifici distribuiti. Il vostro lavoro includerà il contributo alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di componenti specifici Rucio e ATLAS, supportando il funzionamento della distribuzione Rucio per l'ATLAS Experiment, e collaborando a stretto contatto con esperti in CERN, la collaborazione ATLAS e la più ampia comunità open-source Rucio. • Aiuta a mantenere i componenti principali di Rucio.

• Esperienza comprovata nell'ingegneria software per sistemi distribuiti, su larga scala o ad alta intensità di dati.
• Forte track record di sviluppo e mantenimento di software di livello di produzione.

• Scopri i servizi di produzione operativi o di supporto in ambienti basati su Linux.
• L'esperienza con distribuzioni containerizzate e l'orchestrazione in ambienti di produzione è altamente auspicabile.
• La familiarità con ambienti di calcolo scientifico e quadri di elaborazione dati su larga scala è un vantaggio.
• Il contributo a progetti software open source o l'esperienza in ambienti di sviluppo distribuiti collaborativi è un bene. Competenze
• Ottima competenza nella programmazione Python.
• Conoscenza dimostrata dei sistemi distribuiti, applicazioni ad alta intensità di dati, reti di computer e tecnologie di database.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are offering a position within the ATLAS Experiment at CERN, contributing to the development and operation of Rucio, a widely used open-source scientific data management system supporting some of the largest scientific collaborations in the world. Experiments such as ATLAS, CMS, Belle II, SKA, DUNE, and others rely on Rucio to manage globally distributed data at the multi-exabyte scale. Rucio is developed across CERN's Research & Computing Sector within the EP-ATL-CO section, which focuses on extending, integrating, and operating the system in support of the ATLAS Experiment. You will join a team of software engineers and computing specialists working on distributed scientific data management. Your work will include contributing to the design and development of Rucio and ATLAS-specific components, supporting the operation of the Rucio deployment for the ATLAS Experiment, and collaborating closely with experts across CERN, the ATLAS collaboration, and the wider Rucio open-source community. You will also contribute to the evolution of the system to meet the data challenges of the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC). Your responsibilities
• Evolve the transfer and policy engines of Rucio to meet HL-LHC scale requirements.
• Improve the usability, scalability, and performance of Rucio for the ATLAS Experiment.
• Contribute to DevOps and operational activities for the ATLAS Rucio production deployment.
• Help maintain core components of Rucio.
• Contribute to the evolution of Rucio within the broader scientific data management community. Your profile
• Proven experience in software engineering for distributed, large-scale, or data-intensive systems.
• Strong track record of developing and maintaining production-grade software.
• Experience in the design and implementation of distributed services, APIs, or data management systems at scale.
• Practical experience with DevOps practices, including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production service operations.
• Experience operating or supporting production services in Linux-based environments.
• Experience with containerised deployments and orchestration in production environments is highly desirable.
• Familiarity with scientific computing environments and large-scale data processing frameworks is an advantage.
• Contribution to open-source software projects or experience in collaborative distributed development environments is an asset. Skills
• Excellent proficiency in Python programming.
• Demonstrated knowledge of distributed systems, data-intensive applications, computer networks, and database technologies.
• Proven experience in software design, system architecture, and CI/CD practices in production environments.
• Proficiency in Linux and Kubernetes-based environments.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in international, multidisciplinary, and distributed development teams.
• Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French. Eligibility criteria:
• You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
• You have a professional background in Computer Science (or a related field) and have either:
• a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
• or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.

Introduzione Si intraprenderà concept e progettazione preliminare e preparerà e implementerà contratti di progettazione e costruzione per la progettazione dettagliata e la costruzione dell'ingegneria civile richiesta per il nuovo FCC Injection Complex da costruire presso il sito CERN di Prevessin, Francia, previa approvazione del progetto FCC. L'ingegneria civile consiste in una struttura in cemento armato a taglio e copertura su 1km di lunghezza e una serie di edifici di superficie per ospitare infrastrutture tecniche ausiliarie Funzioni
• Lavorare con i colleghi dei team di acceleratore e infrastrutture, preparare layout e disegni concettuali e preliminari per le strutture complesse di Injector.
• Preparare le specifiche tecniche e altri documenti contrattuali per l'approvvigionamento di servizi di consulenza di ingegneria civile relativi al complesso di iniezione.
• Gestire i contratti per sviluppare progetti e specifiche di gara e svolgere un ruolo di primo piano nell'approvvigionamento di imprese di ingegneria civile per la costruzione del complesso.
• Gestire gli aspetti tecnici e partecipare agli aspetti commerciali dei contratti per consegnare il complesso. Laurea magistrale o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo dell'ingegneria civile o un campo correlato. Esperienza:
• Esperienza nella progettazione e costruzione di grandi strutture di taglio e copertura e una comprensione tecnica di progettazione e costruzione tunnel annoiati.
• Esperienza nella gestione dei contratti per la progettazione e la costruzione di ingegneria civile.
• Avere un comprovato record di fornire importanti progetti di ingegneria civile come parte di un team. Competenze tecniche:
• Gestione dei progetti.
• Lavoro civile. Competenze comportamentali:
• Realizzare risultati: avere un approccio strutturato e organizzato verso il lavoro; essere in grado di fissare priorità e pianificare i compiti con i risultati in mente.
• Risultati ottenuti: definizione di obiettivi chiari, pietre miliari e realizzabili prima di avviare il lavoro/progetto.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: accettare prontamente nuovi compiti o progetti. Capacità linguistiche: Parlato e scritto inglese, con un impegno per imparare il francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il più presto possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 05.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST. Condizioni di lavoro Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (5 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido Questa posizione comporta:
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione.
• Lavoro a turni, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione. Grado di lavoro: 6-7 Riferimento del lavoro: SCE-PPM-FC-2026-118-LD Campo di lavoro: Ingegneria civile Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Ingegnere civile Vantaggi globali
• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern

Introduction You will undertake concept and preliminary design and prepare and implement design and construction contracts for the detailed design and construction of the civil engineering required for the new FCC Injection Complex to be constructed at the CERN Site in Prevessin, France, subject to FCC project approval. The civil engineering consists of a cut and cover reinforced concrete structure over 1km long and a series of surface buildings to house ancillary technical infrastructure Functions
• Working with colleagues from the accelerator and infrastructure teams, prepare conceptual and preliminary layouts and designs for the Injector complex structures.
• Prepare technical specifications and other contract documents for the procurement of civil engineering consultancy services related to the injection complex.
• Manage contracts to develop tender designs and specification and play a lead role in the procurement of civil engineering contractors for the construction of the complex.
• Manage the technical aspects and participate in the commercial aspects of the contracts to deliver the complex. Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Civil Engineering or a related field.   Experience:
• Experience in the design and construction of major cut and cover structures and a technical understanding of bored tunnel design and construction.
• Experience in managing contracts for civil engineering design and construction.
• Have a proven record of delivering major civil engineering projects as part of a team. Technical competencies:
• Project management.
• Civil work. Behavioural competencies:
• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
• Achieving Results: defining clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.
• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
• Demonstrating Flexibility: readily accepting new tasks or work/projects. Language skills: Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French. Eligibility and closing date: Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States . This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 05.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST. Employment Conditions Contract type: Limited duration contract (5 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position. Working Hours: 40 hours per week Job Flexibility: Hybrid This position involves:
• A valid driving licence.
• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
• Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization. Job grade: 6-7 Job reference: SCE-PPM-FC-2026-118-LD Field of work: Civil Engineering Benchmark Job Title: Civil Engineer Global Benefits
• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure. Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive. Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART! More information about us, here: careers.cern

Introduzione: Unisciti all'Ufficio Gestione delle Risorse nel Dipartimento di Fisica Sperimentale di Collaborazione CMS, nella sezione EP-CMS-ORG e fornire un servizio senza soluzione di continuità ai molti scienziati provenienti da tutto il mondo. Funzioni:
• Monitorare il pagamento di indennità di costo e di soggiorno per i membri associati del personale e seguire le relative allocazioni di bilancio.
• Coordinare diverse questioni relative ai contributi alla collaborazione CMS, tra cui l'emissione di fatture per i bilanci annuali e il collegamento con i rappresentanti delle Agenzie di Finanziamento.
• Fornire supporto amministrativo alla gestione; analizzare e seguire le questioni finanziarie relative a ordini, fatture e pagamenti di varie tipologie.
• Preparare e mantenere rapporti finanziari, pagine web, file condivisi e record per garantire informazioni accurate e aggiornate.
• Gestire i contratti Project Associate e Experimental Associate nel rispetto delle regole e delle procedure del CERN.
• Fornire supporto amministrativo e orientamento a tutte le categorie di membri del personale, compresa l'organizzazione delle loro formalità di arrivo e partenza.
• Organizzare, programmare e coordinare riunioni, eventi e attività amministrative correlate.
• Assistere nella preparazione, nel monitoraggio e nel follow-up delle richieste di bilancio e delle allocazioni, nonché Memoranda di comprensione e accordi specifici con gli istituti che aderiscono alla collaborazione CMS.
• Assicurare la corretta applicazione delle norme, dei regolamenti e delle procedure amministrative del CERN in varie situazioni.
• Agire come supporto al supervisore durante il periodo di assenza.
• Laurea o equivalente esperienza rilevante nel campo delle finanze e degli appalti, Business Administration o un campo relativo.
• Esperienza dimostrata in un servizio amministrativo/finanziario in un ambiente internazionale. Esperienza:
• Esperienza nel supporto amministrativo e finanziario professionale con forte capacità di gestire ordini, fatture, monitorare i pagamenti in arrivo e garantire il rispetto delle procedure amministrative organizzative.
• Forte capacità di supportare dipartimenti scientifici su larga scala, esperimenti e gruppi multidisciplinari attraverso un coordinamento efficiente e una consegna di servizi di alta qualità.
• Esperienza dei processi di gestione relativi a contributi speciali, eventi e attività operative, mantenendo un flusso di informazioni accurato.
• Ottima comunicazione, capacità organizzative e collaborative per supportare comunità scientifiche internazionali e multiculturali.
• Dimostra una mentalità proattiva, un impegno per l'apprendimento continuo e la crescita professionale, e la capacità di fornire un lavoro di alta qualità in ambienti dinamici e esigenti. Competenze tecniche:
• Controllo e analisi contabili.
• Rapporto finanziario e analisi.
• Utilizzo di pacchetti software per uffici: mS Office e MS Excel; Power Bi è un plus.
• Servizio clienti:: esperienza con incontri coordinati ed eventi, un vantaggio forte.
• L'uso di e il sistema di gestione dei contenuti web come WordPress o simile, è un vantaggio.
• Attuazione dei processi e delle procedure amministrative. Competenze comportamentali:
• Dimostrare Flessibilità: adattare rapidamente e con risorse a spostare le priorità e i requisiti.
• Dimostrare la Responsabilità: lavorare in modo cosciente e affidabile; fornire promesse.
• Realizzare risultati: avere un approccio strutturato e organizzato verso il lavoro; essere in grado di fissare priorità e pianificare i compiti con i risultati in mente.
• Risolvere i problemi: anticipare gli ostacoli; valutare soluzioni alternative per avere un piano di riduzione.
• Comunicare efficacemente: garantire che le informazioni, le procedure e le decisioni siano adeguatamente documentate. Capacità linguistiche:
• Ha parlato e scritto sia inglese che francese. Ammissibilità e chiusura: La diversità è parte integrante della missione del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione ed è un valore consolidato dell'Organizzazione. Sfruttare una forza lavoro diversificata è fondamentale per il nostro successo. Accogliamo con favore le domande di tutti gli Stati membri e degli Stati membri associati. Questa vacanza sarà riempita il più presto possibile, e le applicazioni dovrebbero normalmente raggiungerci non oltre 05.07.2026 a 23:59 CEST. Condizioni di lavoro: Tipo di contratto: contratto di durata limitata (2 anni). Fatto salvo determinate condizioni, i titolari di contratti a durata limitata possono richiedere una posizione a tempo indeterminato. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore a settimana Flessibilità del lavoro: ibrido Questa posizione comporta:
• Una patente di guida valida.
• Lavorare durante le notti, la domenica e le vacanze ufficiali, quando richiesto dalle esigenze dell'Organizzazione. Grado di lavoro: 4-5 Riferimento del lavoro: EP-CMS-ORG-2026-120-LD Campo di lavoro: Servizi di supporto (Finance, HR, Legale, Procurement) Benchmark Titolo del lavoro: Financial Support Officer Vantaggi globali
• Uno stipendio competitivo (gratuito fiscale), in linea con gli anni di esperienza rilevante.
• 30 giorni di congedo retribuito all'anno più 2 settimane di chiusura annuale.
• Copertura dell’assicurazione sanitaria completa del CERN (per te, il tuo coniuge e i tuoi figli) e dell’iscrizione al CERN Pension Fund.
• Indennità mensili di famiglia, bambino e bambino a seconda delle circostanze individuali.
• Un pacchetto di trasferimento (concessione di installazione, rimozione, spese di viaggio) a seconda delle vostre circostanze individuali.
• Possibilità di estendere il contratto fino a 8 anni + ammissibilità per un periodo di tempo indeterminato. Panoramica del CERN - Scopri un mondo in cui l'impossibile è reso possibile! Al CERN, l'Organizzazione europea per la ricerca nucleare, stiamo spingendo le frontiere della scienza e della tecnologia. Il nostro lavoro innovativo riunisce non solo i fisici, ma anche una vasta gamma di professionisti provenienti da settori ingegneristici, tecnici, scientifici e amministrativi. Insieme, promuoviamo un ambiente in cui l'innovazione e la collaborazione prosperano. Ogni giorno affrontiamo nuove entusiasmanti sfide e opportunità per contribuire alla ricerca all'avanguardia che plasma la nostra comprensione dell'universo. Incontriamo queste sfide attraverso le diverse prospettive all'interno dei nostri team, assicurando che ogni contributo sia valutato e guida il nostro senso condiviso di inclusione e scopo. La diversità è un valore fondamentale del CERN fin dalla sua fondazione, e rimane centrale per la nostra missione e il successo continuo. Se siete pronti a far parte di una comunità dinamica e inclusiva che spinge i confini della conoscenza, il CERN è il luogo in cui la vostra curiosità e abilità possono prosperare. Fate parte della nostra missione per scoprire cosa sta nel cuore dell'universo! Partita! Maggiori informazioni su di noi, qui: careers.cern
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction: Join the Resources Management Office in the CMS Collaboration Experimental Physics Department, in the EP-CMS-ORG section and provide a seamless service to the many scientists coming from all over the world. Functions:
• Monitor the payment of cost-of-living allowances and subsistence for associated members of personnel and follow up the related budget allocations.
• Coordinate several matters related to contributions to the CMS collaboration, including the issuance of invoices for the full yearly budgets and liaison with representatives of Funding Agencies.
• Provide administrative support for the management; analyse and follow-up of financial matters related to orders, invoices and payments of various types.
• Prepare and maintain financial reports, web pages, shared files, and records to ensure accurate and up-to-date information.
• Manage Project Associate and Experimental Associate contracts in compliance with CERN rules and procedures.
• Provide administrative support and guidance to all categories of members of personnel, including the organisation of their arrival and departure formalities.
• Organise, schedule and coordinate meetings, events and related administrative activities.
• Assist in the preparation, monitoring, and follow-up of budgets requests and allocations, as well as Memoranda of Understanding and specific agreements with institutes joining the CMS collaboration.
• Ensure the correct application of CERN rules, regulations and administrative procedures in a variety of situations.
• Act as a back-up to the supervisor during period of absence.
• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of of Finance and Procurement, Business Administration or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in an administrative/financial service in an international environment. Experience:
• Experience in administrative and financial support professional with strong ability to manage orders, invoices, monitor incoming payments, and ensure compliance with organisational administrative procedures.
• Strong ability to support large-scale scientific departments, experiments and multidisciplinary groups through efficient coordination and high-quality service delivery.
• Experience managing processes related to special contributions, events, and operational activities while maintaining accurate information flow.
• Excellent communication, organisational and collaborating skills to support international and multicultural scientific communities.
• Demonstrates a proactive mindset, a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth, and the ability to deliver high-quality work in dynamic and demanding environments. Technical competencies:
• Accounting control and analysis.
• Financial reporting and analysis.
• Use of office software packages: mS Office and MS Excel; Power Bi is a plus.
• Customer service: : experience with coordinating meetings and events, a strong plus.
• Use of and web content management system such as WordPress or similar, is an advantage.
• Implementation of administrative processes and procedures. Behavioural competencies:
• Demonstrating Flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
• Demonstrating Accountability: working conscientiously and reliably; delivering on promises.
• Achieving Results: having a structured and organised approach towards work; being able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
• Solving Problems: anticipating obstacles; assessing alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
• Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented. Language skills:
• Spoken and written both English and French. Eligibility and closing date: Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States . This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 05.07.2026 at 23:59 CEST. Employment Conditions: Contract type: Limited duration contract (2 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position. Working Hours: 40 hours per week Job Flexibility: Hybrid This position involves:
• A valid driving licence.
• Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization. Job grade: 4-5 Job reference: EP-CMS-ORG-2026-120-LD Field of work: Support Services (Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement) Benchmark Job Title: Financial Support Officer Global Benefits
• A competitive salary  (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
• 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
• Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
• Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
• A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
• Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure. Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive. Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success. If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe!  TAKE PART! More information about us, here: careers.cern

Einleitung: Treten Sie dem Resources Management Office in der CMS Collaboration Experimental Physics Department in der EP-CMS-ORG-Sektion bei und bieten Sie einen nahtlosen Service für die vielen Wissenschaftler aus der ganzen Welt. Funktionen:
• Überwachung der Zahlung der Lebenshaltungskostenzulagen und des Lebensunterhalts für assoziierte Mitarbeiter und Überwachung der entsprechenden Haushaltsmittelzuweisungen.
• Koordinieren Sie mehrere Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Beiträgen zur CMS-Zusammenarbeit, einschließlich der Ausstellung von Rechnungen für die gesamten Jahreshaushalte und der Verbindung mit Vertretern der Förderagenturen.
• Bereitstellung administrativer Unterstützung für das Management; Analyse und Nachverfolgung von Finanzangelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Bestellungen, Rechnungen und Zahlungen verschiedener Art.
• Bereiten und pflegen Sie Finanzberichte, Webseiten, freigegebene Dateien und Aufzeichnungen, um genaue und aktuelle Informationen zu gewährleisten.
• Verwalten Sie Project Associate- und Experimental Associate-Verträge in Übereinstimmung mit den CERN-Regeln und -Verfahren.
• Bereitstellung administrativer Unterstützung und Anleitung für alle Kategorien von Mitarbeitern, einschließlich der Organisation ihrer Ankunfts- und Abreiseformalitäten.
• Organisation, Planung und Koordinierung von Sitzungen, Veranstaltungen und damit zusammenhängenden Verwaltungstätigkeiten.
• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung, Überwachung und Weiterverfolgung von Budgetanfragen und -zuweisungen sowie von Absichtserklärungen und spezifischen Vereinbarungen mit Instituten, die der CMS-Zusammenarbeit beitreten.
• Gewährleistung der korrekten Anwendung der CERN-Regeln, -Vorschriften und -Verwaltungsverfahren in einer Vielzahl von Situationen.
• Handeln Sie als Backup für den Vorgesetzten während der Abwesenheit.
• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige einschlägige Erfahrung im Bereich Finanzen und Beschaffung, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer administrativen / finanziellen Dienstleistung in einem internationalen Umfeld. Erfahrung:
• Erfahrung in administrativer und finanzieller Unterstützung mit starker Fähigkeit, Bestellungen, Rechnungen zu verwalten, eingehende Zahlungen zu überwachen und die Einhaltung organisatorischer Verwaltungsverfahren zu gewährleisten.
• Starke Fähigkeit, große wissenschaftliche Abteilungen, Experimente und multidisziplinäre Gruppen durch effiziente Koordination und qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen zu unterstützen.
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Prozessen im Zusammenhang mit speziellen Beiträgen, Ereignissen und operativen Aktivitäten bei gleichzeitiger Aufrechterhaltung eines genauen Informationsflusses.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation, organisatorische und kooperative Fähigkeiten zur Unterstützung internationaler und multikultureller wissenschaftlicher Gemeinschaften.
• Zeigt eine proaktive Denkweise, ein Engagement für kontinuierliches Lernen und berufliches Wachstum sowie die Fähigkeit, qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit in dynamischen und anspruchsvollen Umgebungen zu liefern. Technische Kompetenzen:
• Buchhaltungskontrolle und Analyse.
• Finanzberichterstattung und Analyse.
• Verwendung von Office-Softwarepaketen: mS Office und MS Excel; Power Bi ist ein Plus.
• Kundenservice: Erfahrung mit der Koordination von Meetings und Veranstaltungen, ein starkes Plus.
• Der Einsatz und das Web Content Management System wie WordPress oder ähnliches ist von Vorteil.
• Umsetzung von Verwaltungsprozessen und -verfahren. Verhaltenskompetenzen:
• Flexibilität demonstrieren: schnelle und einfallsreiche Anpassung an sich verändernde Prioritäten und Anforderungen.
• Nachweis der Rechenschaftspflicht: gewissenhaft und zuverlässig arbeiten; Versprechen halten.
• Ergebnisse erzielen: Einen strukturierten und organisierten Ansatz für die Arbeit haben; in der Lage sein, Prioritäten zu setzen und Aufgaben unter Berücksichtigung der Ergebnisse zu planen.
• Probleme lösen: Hindernisse antizipieren; alternative Lösungen bewerten, um einen Rückfallplan zu haben.
• Effektiv kommunizieren: Sicherstellen, dass Informationen, Verfahren und Entscheidungen angemessen dokumentiert werden. Sprachkenntnisse:
• Gesprochen und geschrieben sowohl Englisch als auch Französisch. Förderfähigkeit und Stichtag: Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein integraler Bestandteil der Mission des CERN und ist ein fester Wert der Organisation. Die Beschäftigung einer vielfältigen Belegschaft ist zentral für unseren Erfolg. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aus allen Mitgliedstaaten und assoziierten Mitgliedstaaten. Diese freie Stelle wird so schnell wie möglich besetzt, und Anträge sollten uns normalerweise spätestens am 05.07.2026 um 23:59 Uhr erreichen. Beschäftigungsbedingungen: Vertragsart: Befristeter Vertrag (2 Jahre). Unter bestimmten Bedingungen können Inhaber von befristeten Verträgen eine unbefristete Position beantragen. Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche Arbeitsplatzflexibilität: Hybrid Diese Position umfasst:
• Ein gültiger Führerschein.
• Arbeiten in den Nächten, Sonntagen und offiziellen Feiertagen, wenn es die Bedürfnisse der Organisation erfordern. Job Grade: 4-5 Berufsbezeichnung: EP-CMS-ORG-2026-120-LD Arbeitsbereich: Support Services (Finanzen, HR, Recht, Beschaffung) Benchmark Job Title: Financial Support Officer Globale Vorteile
• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt (steuerfrei), das im Einklang mit Ihrer jahrelangen relevanten Erfahrung steigt.
• 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr plus 2 Wochen jährliche Schließung.
• Deckung durch die umfassende Krankenversicherung des CERN (für Sie, Ihren Ehepartner und Ihre Kinder) und die Mitgliedschaft in der CERN-Pensionskasse.
• Familien-, Kinder- und Säuglingszulagen, abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Ein Umzugspaket (Installationszuschuss, Umzug, Reisekosten) abhängig von Ihren individuellen Umständen.
• Möglichkeit, Ihren Vertrag bis zu 8 Jahre + Anspruch auf unbefristete Vertragsdauer zu verlängern. Überblick über CERN - Entdecken Sie eine Welt, in der das Unmögliche möglich gemacht wird! Bei CERN, der Europäischen Organisation für Kernforschung, erweitern wir die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Technologie. Unsere bahnbrechende Arbeit bringt nicht nur Physiker zusammen, sondern auch eine Vielzahl von Fachleuten aus den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Technik, Wissenschaft und Verwaltung. Gemeinsam fördern wir ein Umfeld, in dem Innovation und Zusammenarbeit gedeihen. Jeden Tag stehen wir vor spannenden neuen Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, einen Beitrag zur Spitzenforschung zu leisten, die unser Verständnis des Universums prägt. Wir begegnen diesen Herausforderungen durch die vielfältigen Perspektiven in unseren Teams, stellen sicher, dass jeder Beitrag wertgeschätzt wird und fördern unser gemeinsames Gefühl von Inklusion und Zweck. Vielfalt ist seit ihrer Gründung ein zentraler Wert des CERN und bleibt für unsere Mission und unseren anhaltenden Erfolg von zentraler Bedeutung. Wenn Sie bereit sind, Teil einer dynamischen, integrativen Gemeinschaft zu sein, die die Grenzen des Wissens überschreitet, ist CERN der Ort, an dem Ihre Neugier und Ihre Fähigkeiten gedeihen können. Seien Sie Teil unserer Mission, das aufzudecken, was im Herzen des Universums liegt! TEIL! Mehr Informationen über uns, hier: careers.cern

Introduction: Rejoignez le Bureau de gestion des ressources au Département de physique expérimentale de collaboration de la SMC, dans la section EP-CMS-ORG et offrez un service sans faille aux nombreux scientifiques du monde entier. Fonctions:
• Surveiller le versement des indemnités de subsistance et de coût de la vie aux membres du personnel associés et suivre les allocations budgétaires correspondantes.
• Coordonner plusieurs questions liées aux contributions à la collaboration de la SMC, notamment l'émission de factures pour les budgets annuels complets et la liaison avec les représentants des organismes de financement.
• Fournir un appui administratif à la direction; analyser et suivre les questions financières liées aux commandes, aux factures et aux paiements de divers types.
• Préparer et tenir à jour des rapports financiers, des pages Web, des dossiers partagés et des dossiers afin d'assurer l'exactitude et la mise à jour de l'information.
• Gérer les contrats d'associé de projet et d'associé expérimental conformément aux règles et procédures du CERN.
• Fournir un soutien administratif et des conseils à toutes les catégories de membres du personnel, y compris l'organisation de leurs formalités d'arrivée et de départ.
• Organiser, planifier et coordonner les réunions, les manifestations et les activités administratives connexes.
• Aider à la préparation, au suivi et au suivi des demandes de budget et des allocations, ainsi que des protocoles d'entente et des ententes spécifiques avec les instituts qui se joignent à la collaboration de la SMC.
• Assurer la bonne application des règles, règlements et procédures administratives du CERN dans diverses situations.
• Agir à titre de soutien au superviseur pendant la période d'absence.
• Baccalauréat ou expérience pertinente équivalente dans le domaine des finances et de l'approvisionnement, de l'administration des affaires ou d'un domaine connexe.
• Expérience démontrée dans un service administratif/financier dans un environnement international. Expérience :
• Expérience en matière de soutien administratif et financier professionnel avec une forte capacité de gérer les commandes, les factures, de surveiller les paiements entrants et de veiller au respect des procédures administratives organisationnelles.
• Forte capacité d'appuyer les grands départements scientifiques, les expériences et les groupes multidisciplinaires grâce à une coordination efficace et à une prestation de services de haute qualité.
• Expérience de la gestion des processus liés aux contributions spéciales, aux événements et aux activités opérationnelles tout en maintenant un flux d'information précis.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, organisation et collaboration pour soutenir les communautés scientifiques internationales et multiculturelles.
• Démontrer un état d'esprit proactif, un engagement envers l'apprentissage continu et la croissance professionnelle, et la capacité d'offrir un travail de haute qualité dans des environnements dynamiques et exigeants. Compétences techniques:
• Contrôle comptable et analyse.
• Rapports financiers et analyse.
• Utilisation de logiciels de bureau : mS Office et MS Excel; Power Bi est un plus.
• Service à la clientèle : expérience dans la coordination des réunions et des événements, un plus fort.
• L'utilisation et le système de gestion de contenu web comme WordPress ou similaire, est un avantage.
• Mise en œuvre des processus et procédures administratifs. Compétences comportementales :
• Démontrer la souplesse : s'adapter rapidement et avec ressources à l'évolution des priorités et des besoins.
• Démontrer la responsabilité : travailler consciencieusement et de manière fiable; tenir les promesses.
• Atteindre des résultats: avoir une approche structurée et organisée du travail; être en mesure de fixer des priorités et de planifier des tâches en tenant compte des résultats.
• Résoudre les problèmes : anticiper les obstacles; évaluer d'autres solutions afin d'avoir un plan de recul.
• Communiquer efficacement : s'assurer que l'information, les procédures et les décisions sont dûment documentées. Compétences linguistiques :
• Parlé et écrit à la fois anglais et français. • Un permis de conduire valide.
• Travaillez pendant les nuits, les dimanches et les jours fériés, lorsque les besoins de l ' Organisation l ' exigent. Niveau d'emploi: 4-5 Référence professionnelle: EP-CMS-ORG-2026-120-LD Domaine d ' activité : Services d ' appui (finances, ressources humaines, services juridiques, achats) Titre du poste-repère : Agent de soutien financier Avantages globaux
• Un salaire compétitif (sans impôt), augmentant en fonction de vos années d'expérience pertinente.
• 30 jours de congé payé par an plus 2 semaines de fermeture annuelle.

• Allocations mensuelles pour la famille, l'enfant et l'enfant selon votre situation personnelle.
• Un forfait de réinstallation (subvention d'installation, déménagement, frais de déplacement) selon votre situation personnelle.
• Possibilité de prolonger votre contrat jusqu'à 8 ans + éligibilité à un contrat de durée indéterminée. Aperçu du CERN - Découvrez un monde où l'impossible est rendu possible ! Au CERN, l'Organisation européenne pour la recherche nucléaire, nous repoussons les frontières de la science et de la technologie. Notre travail novateur rassemble non seulement des physiciens, mais aussi des professionnels de l'ingénierie, de la technique, de la science et de l'administration. Ensemble, nous favorisons un environnement où l'innovation et la collaboration prospèrent. Chaque jour, nous faisons face à de nouveaux défis passionnants et à de nouvelles occasions de contribuer à la recherche de pointe qui façonne notre compréhension de l'univers. Nous relevons ces défis grâce aux diverses perspectives au sein de nos équipes, en veillant à ce que chaque contribution soit valorisée et à ce que notre sens commun de l'inclusion et de l'objectif soit déterminé. La diversité est une valeur fondamentale du CERN depuis sa fondation, et elle demeure au cœur de notre mission et de notre succès continu.
